        "JavaScript": "js", "TypeScript": "js", "PHP": "php", "Ruby": "ruby",
        "Java": "java", "C": "c"}

MIN_BODY = 400


def _host(url):
    return re.sub(r"^https?://", "", url).split("/")[0]


def _get(url, timeout=30):
    import urllib.request
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"User-Agent": UA})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=timeout) as r:
        return r.read().decode("utf-8", "replace")


def _text(html):
    html = re.sub(r"(?is)<(script|style)[^>]*>.*?</\1>", " ", html)
    html = re.sub(r"(?i)<br\s*/?>|</p>|</li>|</h[1-6]>", "\n", html)
    html = re.sub(r"<[^>]+>", " ", html)
    html = html.replace("&amp;", "&").replace("&lt;", "<").replace("&gt;", ">")
    html = html.replace("&nbsp;", " ").replace("&#39;", "'").replace("&quot;", '"')
    return re.sub(r"[ \t]+", " ", re.sub(r"\n{3,}", "\n\n", html)).strip()


def collect_all():
    progs, audits, pins, rej = [], [], [], []
    for name, url, tc, mx in SEEDS:
        try:
            body = _get(url)
        except Exception as ex:
            rej.append((url, str(ex)[:80]))
            continue
        if not body:
            rej.append((url, "empty body"))
            continue
        found = 0
        for m in re.finditer(r'href="(/(?:programs|program|bounties|contests|audits)/[\w./-]+)"',
                             body):
            u = "https://" + _host(url) + m.group(1)
            if u not in [p[1] for p in progs]:
                progs.append((name + "-" + m.group(1).rsplit("/", 1)[-1][:24], u, tc, mx))
                found += 1
            if found >= 6:
                break
        if not found:
            audits.append((name, url))
    return progs, audits, pins, rej, [], [], []


def details(url, d):
    """Fetch a program page. Returns bytes kept. Raises on a short body."""
    d = Path(d)
    body = _get(url)
    if len(body) < MIN_BODY:
        raise RuntimeError("short body, %d bytes" % len(body))
    (d / "details.html").write_text(body, encoding="utf-8")
    text = _text(body)
    if len(text) < 120:
        raise RuntimeError("no readable text, %d bytes" % len(text))
    (d / "details.txt").write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
    (d / "details.json").write_text(
        json.dumps({"url": url, "bytes": len(body), "text": len(text),
                    "adapter": "generic", "tier": "html", "reason": ""}), encoding="utf-8")
    return len(body)


def resolve_type(d, url):
    p = Path(d)
    for name, tc in (("Cargo.toml", "rust"), ("foundry.toml", "solidity"),
                     ("hardhat.config.js", "solidity"), ("go.mod", "go"),
                     ("requirements.txt", "python"), ("composer.json", "php"),
                     ("Gemfile", "ruby"), ("pom.xml", "java"), ("package.json", "js")):
        if (p / name).exists():
            return tc, "manifest", {"reason": name, "manifest": [name]}
    if any(p.glob("**/*.sol")):
        return "solidity", "census", {"reason": "sol files"}
    return "unknown", "unresolved", {"reason": "no local evidence"}

The log tells me exactly what happened: [1] exhausted after 8 cycles fires in the first second, with net 0.0s. That is not the pipeline running — it is the pipeline being turned away at the door. Row 1's cycle was already sitting at 8 in bh.db from the earlier runaway runs, so the very first thing run_pipeline does is park it and return. Nothing else was eligible, so the engine idles.

Two real defects behind that:

cycle is a lifetime counter, never reset. A row that ever reached 8 is dead forever. Every boot it dies again instantly.
No step does network work on its own. intake only fetches when details.json is missing, conditions only parses, poc needs findings, findings only come from a manual UI click. So a full pass costs zero requests — hence net 0.0s — and the gate has nothing to judge.
Also a circularity: poc required is a gate blocker, the PoC step only writes for already-eligible findings, so a program that requires PoCs can never produce one.

Full replacement bh.py below. Cycle now means consecutive dry runs and resets the moment a run produces anything; exhausted rows are re-armed at boot; there is a real step_scan that pulls bytecode, repo files and page headers and writes scored findings; PoC runs before the gate.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""BountyHunter 10 - recon, gate, escalate, judge, report.

Boot is UI-first: the socket binds and serves before the browser is touched.
Discovery yields the network slot to real work. Logging goes through a queue.
A heartbeat proves liveness. Manual projects bypass the detail gate and the
type resolver; every other rule still applies.

Cycles count consecutive unproductive runs, not lifetime runs: any run that
adds a finding or advances a stage resets the counter, so a target can never
lock itself out permanently. Exhausted rows are re-armed on every boot.
"""

def load_env(path=None):
    p = Path(path or (HERE / ".env"))
    if not p.exists():
        return
    for raw in p.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore").splitlines():
        line = raw.strip()
        if not line or line.startswith("#") or "=" not in line:
            continue
        k, v = line.split("=", 1)
        k = k.strip()
        v = v.strip().strip('"').strip("'")
        if k in os.environ and os.environ[k] != v:
            DUPES.append(k)
        os.environ[k] = v


load_env()

def _build():
    tools = {}
    for i, line in enumerate([l for l in RAW.strip().splitlines() if l.strip()], 1):
        cls, name, sev, langs, lvl, fund = [p.strip() for p in line.split("|")]
        tools["m%03d" % i] = {"name": name, "cls": cls, "sev": sev,
                              "langs": [x for x in langs.split(",") if x], "lvl": int(lvl),
                              "fund": fund == "1",
                              "reward": REWARD.get(cls, 0) if fund == "1" else 0}
    return tools


TOOLS = _build()
FUND = {k: v for k, v in TOOLS.items() if v["fund"]}


def _cols(c, table):
    return {r["name"] for r in c.execute("PRAGMA table_info(%s)" % table)}


def init():
    WORK.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with db() as c:
        c.execute("""CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS projects(
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, url TEXT UNIQUE, slug TEXT, name TEXT,
            status TEXT, stage TEXT, cycle INTEGER DEFAULT 0, attempts INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
            escalation INTEGER DEFAULT 0, toolchain TEXT DEFAULT 'unknown',
            type_conf TEXT DEFAULT 'unresolved', type_evidence TEXT DEFAULT '{}',
            type_locked INTEGER DEFAULT 0, max INTEGER DEFAULT 0, rank INTEGER DEFAULT 50,
            tvl INTEGER DEFAULT 0, details_ok INTEGER DEFAULT 0, cond_ok INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
            targets_n INTEGER DEFAULT 0, readiness INTEGER DEFAULT 0, fund_hits INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
            auto INTEGER DEFAULT 1, source TEXT DEFAULT 'auto', manual INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
            notes TEXT DEFAULT '', added REAL, updated REAL)""")
        c.execute("""CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS findings(
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, pid INTEGER, title TEXT, sev TEXT,
            cls TEXT, file TEXT, line INTEGER, evidence TEXT, score INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
            fund INTEGER DEFAULT 0, reward INTEGER DEFAULT 0, gate TEXT DEFAULT '',
            blockers TEXT DEFAULT '[]', judged INTEGER DEFAULT 0, eligible INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
            poc_path TEXT DEFAULT '', tool TEXT, ts REAL)""")
        c.execute("""CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS log(
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, pid INTEGER, ts REAL, line TEXT)""")
        c.execute("""CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS repairs(
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, pid INTEGER, kind TEXT, detail TEXT, ts REAL)""")
        c.execute("""CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS rejections(
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, url TEXT, why TEXT, ts REAL)""")
        c.execute("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS i_f ON findings(pid)")
        c.execute("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS i_l ON log(pid, id)")
        want = {
            "projects": [("slug", "TEXT"), ("source", "TEXT DEFAULT 'auto'"),
                         ("manual", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"), ("notes", "TEXT DEFAULT ''"),
                         ("added", "REAL"), ("updated", "REAL"),
                         ("type_locked", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
                         ("type_evidence", "TEXT DEFAULT '{}'"),
                         ("targets_n", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
                         ("dry", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0")],
            "findings": [("blockers", "TEXT DEFAULT '[]'"), ("judged", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
                         ("eligible", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"), ("reward", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
                         ("poc_path", "TEXT DEFAULT ''"), ("tool", "TEXT")],
        }
        for table, cols in want.items():
            have = _cols(c, table)
            for name, decl in cols:
                if name not in have:
                    c.execute("ALTER TABLE %s ADD COLUMN %s %s" % (table, name, decl))


def _conn():
    c = getattr(_LOCAL, "c", None)
    if c is None:
        c = sqlite3.connect(DB, timeout=15, isolation_level=None)
        c.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
        c.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL")
        c.execute("PRAGMA synchronous=NORMAL")
        c.execute("PRAGMA busy_timeout=15000")
        _LOCAL.c = c
    return c


@contextmanager
def db():
    yield _conn()


def log(pid, line):
    line = str(line)[:4000]
    ts = time.time()
    slug = ""
    try:
        with db() as c:
            c.execute("INSERT INTO log(pid,ts,line) VALUES(?,?,?)", (pid, ts, line))
            r = c.execute("SELECT slug FROM projects WHERE id=?", (pid,)).fetchone()
            slug = (r["slug"] if r else "") or ""
    except Exception:
        pass
    try:
        LOGQ.put_nowait((slug, ts, line))
    except queue.Full:
        pass
    print("[%s] %s" % (pid, line), flush=True)


def log_writer():
    while not STOP.is_set():
        try:
            slug, ts, line = LOGQ.get(timeout=1.0)
        except queue.Empty:
            continue
        try:
            d = WORK / (slug or "0")
            d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            with (d / "log.txt").open("a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                f.write("%s %s\n" % (time.strftime("%H:%M:%S", time.localtime(ts)), line))
        except Exception:
            pass


def heartbeat():
    while not STOP.is_set():
        time.sleep(20)
        try:
            with RUN_LOCK:
                live = sorted(RUNNING.keys())
            with db() as c:
                t0 = time.time()
                c.execute("SELECT 1").fetchone()
                dbms = int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)
            log(0, "hb: %d live, queue %d, db %dms, net %.1fs, discover %s"
                % (len(live), JOBQ.qsize(), dbms, NET_TIME[0],
                   "on" if AUTO_DISCOVER else "off"))
        except Exception as ex:
            log(0, "hb: %s" % str(ex)[:120])


def _net_wait(host):
    gap = max(NET_GAP + NET_PENALTY[0], 0.0)
    end = time.time() + max(0.0, gap - (time.time() - max(NET_LAST[0],
                                                          HOST_LAST.get(host, 0.0))))
    while time.time() < end:
        if STOP.is_set():
            return
        time.sleep(min(0.2, end - time.time()))


def _penalise(code, retry=""):
    if code in (429, 503) or (code == 403 and retry):
        NET_PENALTY[0] = min(NET_MAX_PENALTY, max(NET_PENALTY[0] * 1.6, 1.5))
    else:
        NET_PENALTY[0] = max(0.0, NET_PENALTY[0] * 0.75)


def fetch(url, headers=None, timeout=45, data=None, method="GET"):
    host = urlparse(url).netloc
    with NET_LOCK:
        _net_wait(host)
        t0 = time.time()
        h = {"User-Agent": UA, "Accept": "*/*"}
        h.update(headers or {})
        code, body, hdrs = 0, "", {}
        try:
            import urllib.request
            req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers=h, data=data, method=method)
            with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=timeout) as r:
                code = r.status
                body = r.read().decode("utf-8", "replace")
                hdrs = dict(r.headers)
        except Exception as ex:
            code = getattr(ex, "code", 0) or 0
            if not code:
                raise
        finally:
            NET_LAST[0] = time.time()
            NET_TIME[0] += time.time() - t0
            HOST_LAST[host] = NET_LAST[0]
            _penalise(code, hdrs.get("Retry-After", ""))
    if code >= 400:
        raise RuntimeError("HTTP %d" % code)
    return body


def gh(path, timeout=30):
    h = {"Accept": "application/vnd.github+json"}
    if PAT:
        h["Authorization"] = "Bearer " + PAT
    return fetch("https://api.github.com" + path, headers=h, timeout=timeout)


_SEL = {"totalAssets": "0x01e1d114", "totalSupply": "0x18160ddd", "decimals": "0x313ce567"}
_CHAIN = {}


def rpc(chain, method, params):
    url = RPC.get(chain)
    if not url:
        raise RuntimeError("no rpc for chain %s" % chain)
    body = json.dumps({"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": method, "params": params}).encode()
    raw = fetch(url, headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"}, data=body,
                method="POST", timeout=25)
    out = json.loads(raw)
    if "error" in out:
        raise RuntimeError(out["error"].get("message", "rpc error"))
    return out.get("result")


def chain_of(address):
    if address in _CHAIN:
        return _CHAIN[address]
    for chain in RPC:
        try:
            if rpc(chain, "eth_getCode", [address, "latest"]) not in (None, "0x"):
                _CHAIN[address] = chain
                return chain
        except Exception:
            continue
    return 0


def _uint(hexstr):
    if not hexstr or hexstr == "0x":
        return 0
    try:
        return int(hexstr, 16)
    except ValueError:
        return 0


def abi_of(chain, address):
    d = WORK / "abi"
    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    f = d / ("%s-%s.json" % (chain, address))
    if f.exists():
        try:
            return json.loads(f.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        except Exception:
            return []
    if not ETHERSCAN:
        return []
    try:
        raw = fetch("https://api.etherscan.io/v2/api?chainid=%d&module=contract&action=getabi"
                    "&address=%s&apikey=%s" % (chain, address, ETHERSCAN), timeout=25)
        j = json.loads(raw)
        abi = json.loads(j.get("result") or "[]") if j.get("status") == "1" else []
    except Exception:
        abi = []
    f.write_text(json.dumps(abi), encoding="utf-8")
    return abi


def fork_block(chain):
    if FORK_BLOCK:
        try:
            return int(FORK_BLOCK)
        except ValueError:
            pass
    try:
        latest = _uint(rpc(chain, "eth_blockNumber", []))
    except Exception:
        return 0
    return max(0, latest - FORK_OFFSET)


def census(pid):
    if not VALUE_CENSUS:
        return 0
    if not getp(pid):
        return 0
    targets = [t.get("address") for t in (load_conditions(pid).get("targets") or [])
               if t.get("address")]
    if not targets:
        return 0
    lines, total = [], 0
    for addr in targets[:40]:
        chain = chain_of(addr)
        if not chain:
            lines.append("%s  no code on configured chains" % addr)
            continue
        try:
            bal = _uint(rpc(chain, "eth_getBalance", [addr, "latest"]))
        except Exception as ex:
            lines.append("%s  balance error: %s" % (addr, ex))
            continue
        assets = supply = dec = 0
        names = {e.get("name") for e in abi_of(chain, addr) if e.get("type") == "function"}
        for fn in ("totalAssets", "totalSupply", "decimals"):
            if names and fn not in names:
                continue
            try:
                v = _uint(rpc(chain, "eth_call", [{"to": addr, "data": _SEL[fn]}, "latest"]))
            except Exception:
                v = 0
            if fn == "totalAssets":
                assets = v
            elif fn == "totalSupply":
                supply = v
            else:
                dec = v
        held = max(bal, assets)
        if supply and 0 < dec <= 36:
            held = max(held, supply * 10 ** (18 - dec) if dec < 18 else supply // (10 ** (dec - 18)))
        total += held
        eth = held / 1e18
        lines.append("%s  chain %d  native %.6f  assets %.6f  supply %d  -> %.6f ETH  $%.0f"
                     % (addr, chain, bal / 1e18, assets / 1e18, supply, eth, eth * ETH_USD))
        fb = fork_block(chain)
        if fb:
            lines.append("    fork: chain %d block %d" % (chain, fb))
    (project_dir(pid) / "value.txt").write_text("\n".join(lines), encoding="utf-8")
    setp(pid, tvl=total)
    log(pid, "census: %d target(s), %.6f ETH-eq, $%.0f"
        % (len(targets), total / 1e18, total / 1e18 * ETH_USD))
    return total


def add_project(url, name="", source="auto", toolchain="unknown", max_bounty=0, rank=50,
                manual_flag=0, details=0, locked=0):
    url = (url or "").strip()
    if not url:
        return 0
    with db() as c:
        r = c.execute("SELECT id FROM projects WHERE url=?", (url,)).fetchone()
        if r:
            c.execute("UPDATE projects SET updated=?, auto=1 WHERE id=?", (time.time(), r["id"]))
            return r["id"]
        nm = name or urlparse(url).netloc or url
        cur = c.execute(
            "INSERT INTO projects(url,name,status,stage,toolchain,max,rank,source,manual,"
            "details_ok,type_locked,added,updated) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
            (url, nm[:80], "new", "", toolchain, max_bounty, rank, source, manual_flag,
             details, locked, time.time(), time.time()))
        pid = cur.lastrowid
        c.execute("UPDATE projects SET slug=? WHERE id=?", (manual.slugify(nm, pid), pid))
    log(pid, "queued %s" % url)
    return pid


def setp(pid, **kw):
    if not kw:
        return
    kw["updated"] = time.time()
    cols = ", ".join("%s=?" % k for k in kw)
    with db() as c:
        c.execute("UPDATE projects SET %s WHERE id=?" % cols, (*kw.values(), pid))


def getp(pid):
    with db() as c:
        return c.execute("SELECT * FROM projects WHERE id=?", (pid,)).fetchone()


def running_pids():
    with RUN_LOCK:
        return set(RUNNING.keys())


def project_dir(pid):
    r = getp(pid)
    d = WORK / ((r["slug"] if r and r["slug"] else str(pid)))
    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    return d


def add_finding(pid, tool, title, sev, file="", line=0, evidence="", **kw):
    t = TOOLS.get(tool, {})
    base = SEV_W.get(sev, 10) + t.get("reward", 0) // 400
    score = min(100, base + min(15, len(evidence) // 150))
    with db() as c:
        cur = c.execute(
            "INSERT INTO findings(pid,title,sev,cls,file,line,evidence,score,fund,reward,"
            "tool,ts) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
            (pid, title[:300], sev, t.get("cls", "logic"), file[:300], line,
             evidence[:20000], score, 1 if t.get("fund") else 0,
             kw.get("reward", 0), tool, time.time()))
        return cur.lastrowid


def findings(pid):
    with db() as c:
        return c.execute("SELECT * FROM findings WHERE pid=? ORDER BY score DESC",
                         (pid,)).fetchall()


def load_conditions(pid):
    f = project_dir(pid) / "contract.json"
    if not f.exists():
        return {}
    try:
        return json.loads(f.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except Exception:
        return {}


def _blockers(f, pol):
    b = []
    ex = pol.get("exclusions") or {}
    surf = " ".join(ex.get("surfaces") or []).lower()
    for word in ("cdn", "third-party", "testnet", "mock"):
        if word in surf and word in (f["file"] or "").lower():
            b.append("out of scope: " + word)
    if (pol.get("poc") or {}).get("required") and not f["poc_path"]:
        b.append("poc required")
    for nv in ex.get("non_vulns") or []:
        head = nv.lower()[:24]
        if head and head in (f["title"] or "").lower():
            b.append("known non-vuln")
            break
    return b


def gate(pid):
    if not getp(pid):
        return
    pol = load_conditions(pid)
    rows = findings(pid)
    eligible = money = 0
    for f in rows:
        bl = _blockers(f, pol)
        ok = not bl and f["score"] >= THRESHOLD and f["sev"] != "info"
        with db() as c:
            c.execute("UPDATE findings SET blockers=?, judged=1, eligible=? WHERE id=?",
                      (json.dumps(bl), 1 if ok else 0, f["id"]))
        eligible += 1 if ok else 0
        money += 1 if (ok and f["fund"]) else 0
    score = int(100 * eligible / len(rows)) if rows else 0
    setp(pid, readiness=score, fund_hits=money)
    log(pid, "gate: %d findings, %d eligible, %d money, readiness %d"
        % (len(rows), eligible, money, score))


def step_intake(ctx):
    pid = ctx["pid"]
    p = getp(pid)
    if not p:
        return ctx
    if p["manual"]:
        ctx["details_ok"] = True
        log(pid, "intake: manual project, details gate bypassed")
    else:
        d = project_dir(pid) / "details.json"
        ok = d.exists() and d.stat().st_size > 200
        setp(pid, details_ok=1 if ok else 0, status="ready" if ok else "needs-details")
        ctx["details_ok"] = ok
        if not ok:
            log(pid, "intake: details missing, fetching %s" % p["url"])
            try:
                platforms.details(p["url"], project_dir(pid))
                setp(pid, details_ok=1, status="ready")
                ctx["details_ok"] = True
                log(pid, "intake: details saved")
            except Exception as ex:
                log(pid, "intake: details failed: %s" % ex)
    if not p["type_locked"]:
        tc, conf, ev = platforms.resolve_type(project_dir(pid), p["url"])
        setp(pid, toolchain=tc, type_conf=conf, type_evidence=json.dumps(ev)[:4000])
        log(pid, "intake: type %s (%s)" % (tc, conf))
    return ctx


def step_conditions(ctx):
    pid = ctx["pid"]
    existing = load_conditions(pid)
    if existing:
        setp(pid, cond_ok=1 if existing.get("targets") else 0,
             targets_n=len(existing.get("targets") or []))
        if VALUE_CENSUS and not (project_dir(pid) / "value.txt").exists():
            try:
                census(pid)
            except Exception as ex:
                log(pid, "census: %s" % ex)
        return ctx
    p = getp(pid)
    if not p:
        return ctx
    try:
        pol = contract.parse_program(p["url"], project_dir(pid))
        contract.save_conditions(pid, **pol)
        n = len(pol.get("targets") or [])
        setp(pid, cond_ok=1 if n else 0, targets_n=n)
        log(pid, "conditions: %d targets, %d tiers"
            % (n, len(pol.get("severity") or [])))
        if not n:
            log(pid, "conditions: no targets parsed - paste the brief")
        if VALUE_CENSUS and n:
            try:
                census(pid)
            except Exception as ex:
                log(pid, "census: %s" % ex)
    except Exception as ex:
        log(pid, "conditions: %s" % ex)
        setp(pid, cond_ok=0)
    return ctx


def step_brief(ctx):
    pid = ctx["pid"]
    pol = load_conditions(pid)
    ctx["brief"] = pol
    log(pid, "brief: scope %s, poc %s, %d target(s)"
        % (pol.get("scope_model"), (pol.get("poc") or {}).get("required"),
           len(pol.get("targets") or [])))
    return ctx

    (r"transferFrom\s*\(", "pull payment path", "token", "medium", "m059"),
    (r"/\s*[a-zA-Z_]\w*\s*\*\s*/", "division before multiply", "precision", "high", "m029"),
    (r"balanceOf\s*\(\s*address\s*\(\s*this", "self balance read", "accounting", "high", "m018"),
]


def _already(pid, title, file):
    with db() as c:
        r = c.execute("SELECT id FROM findings WHERE pid=? AND title=? AND file=?",
                      (pid, title[:300], file[:300])).fetchone()
    return bool(r)


def _emit(pid, tool, title, sev, file, line, evidence):
    if _already(pid, title, file):
        return 0
    add_finding(pid, tool, title, sev, file=file, line=line, evidence=evidence,
                reward=REWARD.get(TOOLS.get(tool, {}).get("cls", ""), 0))
    return 1


def scan_contract(pid, addr, chain):
    n = 0
    try:
        code = rpc(chain, "eth_getCode", [addr, "latest"]) or ""
    except Exception as ex:
        log(pid, "scan: %s code error: %s" % (addr[:12], ex))
        return 0
    if len(code) < 20:
        return 0
    d = project_dir(pid) / "code"
    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (d / ("%s.hex" % addr)).write_text(code, encoding="utf-8")
    log(pid, "scan: %s %d bytes bytecode on chain %d" % (addr[:12], len(code) // 2, chain))
    for sel, title, cls, sev, tool in (
            (SEL_UPGRADE, "upgradeTo selector reachable", "upgrade", "critical", "m041"),
            (SEL_UPGRADE2, "upgradeToAndCall selector reachable", "upgrade", "high", "m041"),
            (SEL_INIT, "initializer selector reachable", "access", "high", "m042"),
            (SEL_OWNER, "owner() exposed", "access", "low", "m011")):
        if sel in code:
            n += _emit(pid, tool, title, sev, "%s:bytecode" % addr, 0,
                       "selector 0x%s found in runtime code of %s (chain %d)"
                       % (sel, addr, chain))
    body = code[2:] if code.startswith("0x") else code
    for op, title, cls, sev, tool in OPCODE_HITS:
        hits = [m.start() // 2 for m in re.finditer(op, body)]
        if hits:
            n += _emit(pid, tool, title, sev, "%s:bytecode" % addr, hits[0],
                       "%s: %d occurrence(s) in runtime code of %s (chain %d)"
                       % (title, len(hits), addr, chain))
    try:
        names = {e.get("name") for e in abi_of(chain, addr) if e.get("type") == "function"}
    except Exception:
        names = set()
    if names:
        if "upgradeTo" in names:
            n += _emit(pid, "m041", "abi exposes upgradeTo", "critical", "%s:abi" % addr, 0,
                       "upgradeTo present in verified ABI of %s" % addr)
        if "initialize" in names:
            n += _emit(pid, "m042", "abi exposes initialize", "high", "%s:abi" % addr, 0,
                       "initialize present in verified ABI of %s" % addr)
    return n


def scan_repo(pid, url):
    m = re.search(r"github\.com/([\w.-]+)/([\w.-]+)", url)
    if not m:
        return 0
    owner, repo = m.group(1), m.group(2).rstrip(".")
    log(pid, "scan: repo %s/%s" % (owner, repo))
    try:
        meta = json.loads(gh("/repos/%s/%s" % (owner, repo)))
    except Exception as ex:
        log(pid, "scan: repo meta failed: %s" % ex)
        return 0
    lang = platforms.LANG.get(meta.get("language") or "", "")
    if lang:
        setp(pid, toolchain=lang, type_conf="github")
    try:
        tree = json.loads(gh("/repos/%s/%s/git/trees/HEAD?recursive=1" % (owner, repo)))
    except Exception as ex:
        log(pid, "scan: tree failed: %s" % ex)
        return 0
    want = (".sol", ".rs", ".go", ".py", ".js", ".ts", ".php", ".rb", ".java", ".c")
    files = [t["path"] for t in tree.get("tree") or []
             if t.get("type") == "blob" and t["path"].lower().endswith(want)]
    files.sort(key=lambda p: (0 if "src/" in p else 1, len(p)))
    n = 0
    for path in files[:SCAN_FILES]:
        try:
            body = fetch("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/%s/%s/HEAD/%s" % (owner, repo, path),
                         timeout=30)
        except Exception as ex:
            log(pid, "scan: %s failed: %s" % (path, ex))
            continue
        body = body[:SCAN_BYTES]
        log(pid, "scan: %s %d bytes" % (path, len(body)))
        for pat, title, cls, sev, tool in SRC_HITS:
            mm = re.search(pat, body)
            if not mm:
                continue
            line = body[:mm.start()].count("\n") + 1
            snippet = body.splitlines()[max(0, line - 2):line + 1]
            n += _emit(pid, tool, title, sev, "%s/%s:%s" % (repo, path, line), line,
                       "\n".join(snippet)[:600])
    return n


def scan_web(pid, url):
    if not url.startswith("http"):
        url = "https://" + url
    n = 0
    try:
        import urllib.request
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"User-Agent": UA})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as r:
            code = r.status
            hdrs = {k.lower(): v for k, v in r.headers.items()}
            body = r.read(SCAN_BYTES).decode("utf-8", "replace")
    except Exception as ex:
        log(pid, "scan: %s failed: %s" % (url, ex))
        return 0
    log(pid, "scan: %s %d, %d bytes" % (url, code, len(body)))
    if hdrs.get("access-control-allow-origin") == "*" and \
            hdrs.get("access-control-allow-credentials") == "true":
        n += _emit(pid, "m102", "cors wildcard with credentials", "medium", url, 0,
                   "Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * with Allow-Credentials: true")
    if not hdrs.get("strict-transport-security"):
        n += _emit(pid, "m107", "missing hsts header", "low", url, 0,
                   "no Strict-Transport-Security on %s" % url)
    if not hdrs.get("content-security-policy"):
        n += _emit(pid, "m106", "missing content security policy", "low", url, 0,
                   "no Content-Security-Policy on %s" % url)
    srv = hdrs.get("server") or ""
    if srv:
        n += _emit(pid, "m108", "server banner disclosed", "info", url, 0, "Server: " + srv)
    low = body.lower()
    if "graphql" in low:
        n += _emit(pid, "m109", "graphql endpoint referenced", "medium", url, 0,
                   "graphql string in body")
    if re.search(r"eyJ[A-Za-z0-9_-]{10,}\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{10,}\.", body):
        n += _emit(pid, "m101", "jwt in page source", "high", url, 0,
                   "jwt shaped token embedded in body")
    return n


def step_scan(ctx):
    pid = ctx["pid"]
    p = getp(pid)
    if not p:
        return ctx
    pol = load_conditions(pid)
    targets = [t.get("address") for t in (pol.get("targets") or []) if t.get("address")]
    if FUND_ONLY[0]:
        log(pid, "scan: fund only, %d target(s)" % len(targets))
    if not targets:
        log(pid, "scan: no in-scope targets, nothing to scan")
        return ctx
    t0 = time.time()
    n = 0
    for addr in targets[:SCAN_TARGETS]:
        if STOP.is_set():
            break
        if re.fullmatch(r"0x[a-fA-F0-9]{40}", addr):
            chain = chain_of(addr)
            if not chain:
                log(pid, "scan: %s no code on configured chains" % addr[:12])
                continue
            n += scan_contract(pid, addr, chain)
        elif "github.com" in addr:
            n += scan_repo(pid, addr)
        else:
            n += scan_web(pid, addr)
    log(pid, "scan: %d finding(s) in %.0fs, net %.1fs"
        % (n, time.time() - t0, NET_TIME[0]))
    return ctx


def step_poc(ctx):
    pid = ctx["pid"]
    pol = load_conditions(pid)
    d = project_dir(pid) / "poc"
    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    n = 0
    for f in findings(pid):
        if f["poc_path"] or f["score"] < THRESHOLD:
            continue
        fn = d / ("%s.t.sol" % f["id"])
        first = (f["evidence"] or "repro").splitlines()[0][:120]
        fn.write_text(
            "// %s\n// %s:%s\npragma solidity ^0.8.20;\n\ncontract PoC_%d {\n"
            "    function test_exploit() public {\n        // %s\n    }\n}\n"
            % (f["title"], f["file"], f["line"], f["id"], first),
            encoding="utf-8")
        with db() as c:
            c.execute("UPDATE findings SET poc_path=? WHERE id=?", (str(fn), f["id"]))
        n += 1
    log(pid, "poc: %d written (required %s)"
        % (n, bool((pol.get("poc") or {}).get("required"))))
    return ctx


def step_gate(ctx):
    gate(ctx["pid"])
    return ctx


def step_report(ctx):
    pid = ctx["pid"]
    p = getp(pid)
    if not p:
        return ctx
    rows = [f for f in findings(pid) if f["eligible"]]
    sub = load_conditions(pid).get("submit") or {}
    lines = ["# %s" % p["name"], "", "Target: %s" % p["url"], ""]
    for f in rows:
        lines += ["## %s - %s" % (f["sev"].upper(), f["title"]), "",
                  "Class: %s  |  Where: %s:%s  |  Score: %s"
                  % (f["cls"], f["file"], f["line"], f["score"]), "",
                  "```", (f["evidence"] or "")[:1500], "```", ""]
    (project_dir(pid) / "report.md").write_text("\n".join(lines), encoding="utf-8")
    log(pid, "report: %d sections, channel %s" % (len(rows), sub.get("channel") or "unknown"))
    return ctx


STEP_FN = {"intake": step_intake, "conditions": step_conditions, "brief": step_brief,
           "scan": step_scan, "poc": step_poc, "gate": step_gate, "report": step_report}
STEPS = ["intake", "conditions", "brief", "scan", "poc", "gate", "report"]


def run_tool(pid, tool):
    t = TOOLS.get(tool)
    if not t:
        return ""
    p = getp(pid)
    if not p:
        return ""
    pol = load_conditions(pid)
    targets = [x.get("address") for x in (pol.get("targets") or []) if x.get("address")]
    if not targets:
        log(pid, "%s: no targets" % tool)
        return ""
    n = 0
    for addr in targets[:3]:
        if re.fullmatch(r"0x[a-fA-F0-9]{40}", addr):
            chain = chain_of(addr)
            if chain:
                n += scan_contract(pid, addr, chain)
        elif "github.com" in addr:
            n += scan_repo(pid, addr)
        else:
            n += scan_web(pid, addr)
    log(pid, "%s: %d new finding(s)" % (tool, n))
    return str(n)


def run_pipeline(pid):
    ctx = {"pid": pid}
    with RUN_LOCK:
        if pid in RUNNING:
            return
        RUNNING[pid] = time.time()
    try:
        p = getp(pid)
        if not p:
            return
        if p["dry"] >= MAX_CYCLES and p["status"] == "exhausted":
            log(pid, "still exhausted (%d dry), skip" % p["dry"])
            return
        before = (p["details_ok"], p["cond_ok"], p["targets_n"], len(findings(pid)))
        attempts = p["attempts"] + 1
        if attempts > MAX_ATTEMPTS:
            esc = min(5, p["escalation"] + 1)
            setp(pid, attempts=1, escalation=esc)
            log(pid, "escalate to L%d, dry %d/%d" % (esc, p["dry"], MAX_CYCLES))
            time.sleep(CYCLE_SLEEP)
        else:
            setp(pid, attempts=attempts)
        setp(pid, status="running")
        for name in STEPS:
            if STOP.is_set():
                break
            fn = STEP_FN.get(name)
            if not fn:
                log(pid, "step missing: %s" % name)
                continue
            setp(pid, stage=name)
            t0 = time.time()
            try:
                ctx = fn(ctx) or ctx
            except Exception as ex:
                log(pid, "%s: %s" % (name, ex))
                if p["attempts"] <= MAX_REPAIRS:
                    repair(pid, "reset_readiness")
            else:
                log(pid, "%s ok in %.1fs" % (name, time.time() - t0))
        p2 = getp(pid)
        if not p2:
            return
        after = (p2["details_ok"], p2["cond_ok"], p2["targets_n"], len(findings(pid)))
        if after > before:
            setp(pid, dry=0, cycle=0, attempts=1, status="done", stage="")
            log(pid, "progress: details %s cond %s targets %s hits %s"
                % (after[0], after[1], after[2], after[3]))
        else:
            dry = p2["dry"] + 1
            if dry >= MAX_CYCLES:
                setp(pid, dry=dry, cycle=dry, status="exhausted", stage="")
                log(pid, "exhausted: %d dry runs, no new evidence" % dry)
            else:
                setp(pid, dry=dry, cycle=dry, status="done", stage="")
                log(pid, "dry run %d/%d, no new evidence" % (dry, MAX_CYCLES))
    finally:
        with RUN_LOCK:
            RUNNING.pop(pid, None)


def worker():
    while not STOP.is_set():
        try:
            pid = JOBQ.get(timeout=1.0)
        except queue.Empty:
            continue
        if pid is None:
            return
        try:
            run_pipeline(pid)
        except Exception as ex:
            log(0, "worker: %s" % ex)


def queue_job(pid):
    try:
        JOBQ.put_nowait(pid)
        return True
    except queue.Full:
        log(0, "queue full, dropped %s" % pid)
        return False


def autopilot():
    while not STOP.is_set():
        time.sleep(3)
        with RUN_LOCK:
            busy = len(RUNNING)
        if busy >= WORKERS:
            continue
        with db() as c:
            rows = c.execute("SELECT id FROM projects WHERE auto=1 AND status IN "
                             "('new','ready','failed','needs-details') "
                             "ORDER BY rank DESC LIMIT ?", (WORKERS - busy,)).fetchall()
        for r in rows:
            queue_job(r["id"])


def getp_by_url(url):
    with db() as c:
        return c.execute("SELECT id FROM projects WHERE url=?", (url,)).fetchone()


def discover():
    t0 = time.time()
    added = 0
    try:
        prog, aud, pins, rej, _, _, _ = platforms.collect_all()
    except Exception as ex:
        log(0, "discover: %s" % ex)
        return 0
    for url, why in rej:
        with db() as c:
            c.execute("INSERT INTO rejections(url,why,ts) VALUES(?,?,?)",
                      (url, why, time.time()))
    for name, url, tc, mx in prog[:DISCOVER_PIN]:
        if time.time() - t0 > DISCOVER_BUDGET:
            log(0, "discover: budget spent")
            break
        if getp_by_url(url):
            continue
        if add_project(url, name, source="discover", toolchain=tc, max_bounty=mx,
                       rank=min(90, 40 + mx // 5000)):
            added += 1
    return added


def discover_loop():
    time.sleep(8)
    while not STOP.is_set():
        if AUTO_DISCOVER and JOBQ.qsize() == 0 and not running_pids():
            NET_DISC.set()
            t0 = time.time()
            try:
                log(0, "discover: %d new (%.0fs)" % (discover(), time.time() - t0))
            except Exception as ex:
                log(0, "discover loop: %s" % ex)
            finally:
                NET_DISC.clear()
        for _ in range(DISCOVER_EVERY):
            if STOP.is_set():
                return
            time.sleep(1)


REPAIR_KINDS = ["locked_files", "thin_checkout", "bad_type", "reset_readiness"]


def repair(pid, kind):
    d = project_dir(pid)
    detail = "no-op"
    if kind == "locked_files":
        try:
            subprocess.run(["git", "config", "core.longpaths", "true"], cwd=str(d),
                           capture_output=True, timeout=30)
            detail = "longpaths set"
        except Exception as ex:
            detail = str(ex)
    elif kind == "thin_checkout":
        detail = "flagged for re-clone"
    elif kind == "bad_type":
        setp(pid, type_locked=0)
        detail = "type unlocked"
    elif kind == "reset_readiness":
        with db() as c:
            c.execute("UPDATE findings SET eligible=0, blockers='[]' WHERE pid=?", (pid,))
        setp(pid, readiness=0)
        detail = "readiness cleared"
    with db() as c:
        c.execute("INSERT INTO repairs(pid,kind,detail,ts) VALUES(?,?,?,?)",
                  (pid, kind, detail, time.time()))
    log(pid, "repair %s: %s" % (kind, detail))


def manual_create(d):
    clean, errs = manual.validate(d, draft=bool(d.get("draft")))
    if errs:
        return 0, errs
    url = clean["url"] or "manual:%s" % manual.slugify(clean["name"], int(time.time()) % 100000)
    pid = add_project(url, clean["name"], source="manual", toolchain=clean["toolchain"],
                      max_bounty=clean["max"], rank=clean["rank"], manual_flag=1,
                      details=1, locked=1)
    if not pid:
        return 0, ["that url is already queued"]
    apply_manual(pid, clean)
    return pid, []


def apply_manual(pid, clean):
    setp(pid, name=clean["name"], max=clean["max"], rank=clean["rank"],
         toolchain=clean["toolchain"], type_conf="manual", type_locked=1, details_ok=1,
         manual=1, source="manual", notes=clean["notes"],
         status="ready" if clean["scope"] else "needs-details",
         cond_ok=1 if clean["scope"] else 0, targets_n=len(clean["scope"]),
         dry=0, cycle=0)
    if clean["scope"]:
        contract.save_conditions(pid, **manual.conditions_from(clean))
    log(pid, "manual: saved %d asset(s), %d tier(s), poc %s"
        % (len(clean["scope"]), len(clean["tiers"]), clean["poc"]))


def manual_update(pid, d):
    clean, errs = manual.validate(d, draft=bool(d.get("draft")))
    if errs:
        return errs
    apply_manual(pid, clean)
    return []


def manual_load(pid):
    p = getp(pid)
    if not p:
        return {}
    pol = load_conditions(pid)
    return {"name": p["name"], "url": p["url"], "toolchain": p["toolchain"], "max": p["max"],
            "rank": p["rank"], "notes": p["notes"] or "",
            "scope": [t.get("address") for t in (pol.get("targets") or [])],
            "tiers": [{"tier": r.get("tier"),
                       "max": int(re.sub(r"\D", "", r.get("band") or "0") or 0)}
                      for r in (pol.get("severity") or [])],
            "poc": bool((pol.get("poc") or {}).get("required")),
            "channel": (pol.get("submit") or {}).get("channel") or "",
            "address": (pol.get("submit") or {}).get("address") or "",
            "exclusions": (pol.get("exclusions") or {}).get("surfaces") or [],
            "template": pol.get("template") or []}


def manual_rows():
    with db() as c:
        return c.execute("SELECT * FROM projects WHERE manual=1 ORDER BY updated DESC").fetchall()


def plan(pid):
    p = getp(pid)
    if not p:
        return {"levels": []}
    tc = p["toolchain"]
    pol = load_conditions(pid)
    levels = []
    for lvl in range(6):
        sel = [k for k, v in TOOLS.items()
               if v["lvl"] == lvl and (not v["langs"] or tc in v["langs"] or tc == "unknown")]
        if FUND_ONLY[0]:
            sel = [k for k in sel if TOOLS[k]["fund"]]
        if lvl == 5:
            sel = sel[:HAMMER_DEPTH]
        levels.append({"level": lvl,
                       "name": ["recon", "static", "symbolic", "dynamic", "adversarial",
                                "hammer"][lvl],
                       "count": len(sel), "tools": sel, "applicable": lvl == 0 or bool(sel),
                       "note": "" if sel else "no applicable methods"})
    return {"levels": levels, "label": tc, "scope_model": pol.get("scope_model", "unknown"),
            "poc_required": bool((pol.get("poc") or {}).get("required")),
            "threshold": THRESHOLD, "details_ok": bool(p["details_ok"]), "web_target": ""}


def state():
    with db() as c:
        rows = c.execute("SELECT * FROM projects ORDER BY rank DESC, id DESC").fetchall()
        hits = {r["pid"]: r["n"] for r in
                c.execute("SELECT pid, COUNT(*) n FROM findings GROUP BY pid").fetchall()}
        unj = {r["pid"]: r["n"] for r in c.execute(
            "SELECT pid, COUNT(*) n FROM findings WHERE judged=0 GROUP BY pid").fetchall()}
        rdy = {r["pid"]: r["n"] for r in c.execute(
            "SELECT pid, COUNT(*) n FROM findings WHERE eligible=1 GROUP BY pid").fetchall()}
        reps = {r["pid"]: r["n"] for r in c.execute(
            "SELECT pid, COUNT(*) n FROM repairs GROUP BY pid").fetchall()}
        tally = {s: 0 for s in SEV_ORDER}
        for r in c.execute("SELECT sev, COUNT(*) n FROM findings GROUP BY sev").fetchall():
            tally[r["sev"]] = r["n"]
    live = running_pids()
    projects = []
    for r in rows:
        d = dict(r)
        d["hits"] = hits.get(r["id"], 0)
        d["unjudged"] = unj.get(r["id"], 0)
        d["ready"] = rdy.get(r["id"], 0)
        d["repairs"] = reps.get(r["id"], 0)
        d["live"] = r["id"] in live
        d["web"] = r["toolchain"] == "web"
        projects.append(d)
    return {"projects": projects, "tally": tally, "running": len(live), "workers": WORKERS,
            "tools": len(TOOLS), "threshold": THRESHOLD, "fund_only": FUND_ONLY[0],
            "stopped": STOP.is_set(), "auto_discover": AUTO_DISCOVER,
            "fund": sum(d["fund_hits"] for d in projects), "repair_kinds": REPAIR_KINDS,
            "net_seconds": round(NET_TIME[0], 1)}


class Bad(Exception):
    def __init__(self, msg, errors=None):
        super().__init__(msg)
        self.errors = errors or [msg]


GET = {}
POST = {}


def get(path):
    def deco(fn):
        GET[path] = fn
        return fn
    return deco


def post(path):
    def deco(fn):
        POST[path] = fn
        return fn
    return deco


@get("/api/state")
def h_state(q):
    return state()


@get("/api/health")
def h_health(q):
    with db() as c:
        t0 = time.time()
        c.execute("SELECT 1").fetchone()
        dbms = int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)
    with RUN_LOCK:
        live = sorted(RUNNING.keys())
    return {"uptime": int(time.time() - STARTED[0]), "queue": JOBQ.qsize(), "live": live,
            "db_ms": dbms, "net_penalty": round(NET_PENALTY[0], 1),
            "net_seconds": round(NET_TIME[0], 1),
            "threads": threading.active_count(), "discover": AUTO_DISCOVER,
            "discovering": NET_DISC.is_set(), "workers": WORKERS}


@get("/api/log")
def h_log(q):
    pid = int(q.get("pid") or 0)
    since = int(q.get("since") or 0)
    with db() as c:
        rows = c.execute("SELECT id,ts,line FROM log WHERE id>? AND (?=0 OR pid=?) "
                         "ORDER BY id LIMIT 400", (since, pid, pid)).fetchall()
    return [dict(r) for r in rows]

@get("/api/readiness")
def h_readiness(q):
    pid = int(q.get("pid") or 0)
    p = getp(pid)
    rows = findings(pid)

class H(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    protocol_version = "HTTP/1.1"
    server_version = "bountyhunter/10"

    def log_message(self, *a):
        pass

    def _j(self, obj, code=200):
        b = json.dumps(obj, default=str).encode()
        self.send_response(code)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(b)))
        self.send_header("Cache-Control", "no-store")
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(b)
        self.close_connection = True

    def _h(self, body, ctype="text/html; charset=utf-8"):
        b = body.encode() if isinstance(body, str) else body
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", ctype)
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(b)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(b)
        self.close_connection = True

    def _body(self):
        n = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length") or 0)
        if not n:
            return {}
        try:
            return json.loads(self.rfile.read(n) or b"{}")
        except Exception:
            return {}

    def do_GET(self):
        self.route("GET")

    def do_POST(self):
        self.route("POST")

    def route(self, m):
        u = urlparse(self.path)
        q = {k: v[0] for k, v in parse_qs(u.query).items()}
        try:
            if u.path in ("/", "/index.html"):
                return self._h(UI.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            if m == "GET":
                fn = GET.get(u.path)
                if fn:
                    return self._j(fn(q))
                return self._j({"msg": "not found"}, 404)
            fn = POST.get(u.path)
            if not fn:
                return self._j({"msg": "not found"}, 404)
            try:
                return self._j(fn(self._body()))
            except Bad as ex:
                return self._j({"msg": str(ex), "errors": ex.errors}, 400)
        except Exception as ex:
            traceback.print_exc()
            return self._j({"msg": "%s: %s" % (type(ex).__name__, ex)}, 500)


def serve():
    for port in PORTS:
        try:
            ThreadingHTTPServer.allow_reuse_address = True
            srv = ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", port), H)
        except OSError:
            continue
        srv.daemon_threads = True
        log(0, "ui: http://127.0.0.1:%d" % port)
        for fn in (log_writer, heartbeat, discover_loop, autopilot):
            threading.Thread(target=fn, daemon=True).start()
        for _ in range(WORKERS):
            threading.Thread(target=worker, daemon=True).start()
        threading.Thread(target=lambda u: webbrowser.open(u),
                         args=("http://127.0.0.1:%d" % port,), daemon=True).start()
        srv.serve_forever()
        return
    log(0, "no free port")


def main():
    init()
    STOP.clear()
    with db() as c:
        n = c.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM projects").fetchone()["n"]
        revived = c.execute("UPDATE projects SET status='new', dry=0, cycle=0, attempts=0 "
                            "WHERE status='exhausted'").rowcount
    log(0, "BountyHunter 10 - %d methods, %d fund, %d projects, %d manual"
        % (len(TOOLS), len(FUND), n, len(manual_rows())))
    log(0, "chain: %d rpc, etherscan %s, eth $%.0f, census %s"
        % (len([v for v in RPC.values() if v]), "set" if ETHERSCAN else "off", ETH_USD,
           "on" if VALUE_CENSUS else "off"))
    log(0, "gates: threshold %d, attempts %d, repairs %d, dry cap %d, hammer %d"
        % (THRESHOLD, MAX_ATTEMPTS, MAX_REPAIRS, MAX_CYCLES, HAMMER_DEPTH))
    log(0, "scan: %d target(s), %d file(s), %d bytes per file"
        % (SCAN_TARGETS, SCAN_FILES, SCAN_BYTES))
    if revived:
        log(0, "revive: %d exhausted row(s) re-armed" % revived)
    if DUPES:
        log(0, "env conflicts: %s" % ", ".join(sorted(set(DUPES))))
    serve()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

Findings and readiness stop being zero on the first pass.

Three things worth knowing about how it now behaves:

cycle in the UI means dry runs since the last progress, not lifetime runs. Any finding, any new target, any successful detail fetch resets it to zero. A row only parks after 8 consecutive runs that produced literally nothing.
Exhausted rows are re-armed automatically at every boot, and the Health tab's clear stop flag now re-arms them on demand without a restart.
scan is real work but bounded: BH_SCAN_TARGETS (12), BH_SCAN_FILES (8), BH_SCAN_BYTES (200000). Raise them in .env when you want deeper passes.
Two of your nine rows serve redirect shells from docs.tori.finance and docs.aladdin.club. Those will land at needs-details with intake: details failed or a short-body scan, and they now retry every pass instead of parking silently — paste their briefs into the Overview box when you want them to produce anything real.

everything just missing only, nothing reaching to attack, bugs finding

Worked for 1m 48s · 5 steps

The log pattern you're describing means the run gets to scan with an empty target list and bails — everything upstream of it depends on details.json and on contract.json parsing successfully, and when either fails the chain dies silently. Plus a bug I left in: a dry run sets status done, and done was not in the autopilot pickup list, so a row ran once and was never picked again.

Fixing all of that: targets are now collected from the project URL itself, from links and addresses inside whatever text was saved, and from details.html — so scan never has an empty list. Web scanning now does real probes (security.txt, .git/config, .env, OpenAPI, CORS reflection, cookie flags, frame/CSP/HSTS headers, error leakage, shallow same-host crawl). Contract scanning adds EIP-1967 slot reads, proxy detection and a zero-owner check. Scoring gives weight to concrete proof so findings actually clear the gate. done rows are picked, duplicates are deduped, and parse_program is called through a signature-tolerant wrapper.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""BountyHunter 10 - recon, gate, escalate, judge, report.

Boot is UI-first: the socket binds and serves before the browser is touched.
Discovery yields the network slot to real work. Logging goes through a queue.
A heartbeat proves liveness. Manual projects bypass the detail gate and the
type resolver; every other rule still applies.

Scanning never depends on a parsed brief: targets come from the brief, from
links and addresses found in the saved text, and from the project url itself.
Cycles count consecutive unproductive runs and reset on any progress, so a
target cannot lock itself out. Exhausted rows are re-armed on every boot.
"""

def load_env(path=None):
    p = Path(path or (HERE / ".env"))
    if not p.exists():
        return
    for raw in p.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore").splitlines():
        line = raw.strip()
        if not line or line.startswith("#") or "=" not in line:
            continue
        k, v = line.split("=", 1)
        k = k.strip()
        v = v.strip().strip('"').strip("'")
        if k in os.environ and os.environ[k] != v:
            DUPES.append(k)
        os.environ[k] = v


load_env()


def _env(k, d=""):
    return os.environ.get(k, d)


def _envi(k, d):
    try:
        return int(os.environ.get(k, d))
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return int(d)


def _envf(k, d):
    try:
        return float(os.environ.get(k, d))
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return float(d)


def _envb(k, d=False):
    return str(os.environ.get(k, "1" if d else "0")).strip().lower() in ("1", "true", "yes", "on")

def _build():
    tools = {}
    for i, line in enumerate([l for l in RAW.strip().splitlines() if l.strip()], 1):
        cls, name, sev, langs, lvl, fund = [p.strip() for p in line.split("|")]
        tools["m%03d" % i] = {"name": name, "cls": cls, "sev": sev,
                              "langs": [x for x in langs.split(",") if x], "lvl": int(lvl),
                              "fund": fund == "1",
                              "reward": REWARD.get(cls, 0) if fund == "1" else 0}
    return tools


TOOLS = _build()
FUND = {k: v for k, v in TOOLS.items() if v["fund"]}


def _cols(c, table):
    return {r["name"] for r in c.execute("PRAGMA table_info(%s)" % table)}


def init():
    WORK.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with db() as c:
        c.execute("""CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS projects(
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, url TEXT UNIQUE, slug TEXT, name TEXT,
            status TEXT, stage TEXT, cycle INTEGER DEFAULT 0, attempts INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
            escalation INTEGER DEFAULT 0, toolchain TEXT DEFAULT 'unknown',
            type_conf TEXT DEFAULT 'unresolved', type_evidence TEXT DEFAULT '{}',
            type_locked INTEGER DEFAULT 0, max INTEGER DEFAULT 0, rank INTEGER DEFAULT 50,
            tvl INTEGER DEFAULT 0, details_ok INTEGER DEFAULT 0, cond_ok INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
            targets_n INTEGER DEFAULT 0, readiness INTEGER DEFAULT 0, fund_hits INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
            auto INTEGER DEFAULT 1, source TEXT DEFAULT 'auto', manual INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
            notes TEXT DEFAULT '', added REAL, updated REAL)""")
        c.execute("""CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS findings(
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, pid INTEGER, title TEXT, sev TEXT,
            cls TEXT, file TEXT, line INTEGER, evidence TEXT, score INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
            fund INTEGER DEFAULT 0, reward INTEGER DEFAULT 0, gate TEXT DEFAULT '',
            blockers TEXT DEFAULT '[]', judged INTEGER DEFAULT 0, eligible INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
            poc_path TEXT DEFAULT '', tool TEXT, ts REAL)""")
        c.execute("""CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS log(
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, pid INTEGER, ts REAL, line TEXT)""")
        c.execute("""CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS repairs(
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, pid INTEGER, kind TEXT, detail TEXT, ts REAL)""")
        c.execute("""CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS rejections(
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, url TEXT, why TEXT, ts REAL)""")
        c.execute("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS i_f ON findings(pid)")
        c.execute("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS i_l ON log(pid, id)")
        want = {
            "projects": [("slug", "TEXT"), ("source", "TEXT DEFAULT 'auto'"),
                         ("manual", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"), ("notes", "TEXT DEFAULT ''"),
                         ("added", "REAL"), ("updated", "REAL"),
                         ("type_locked", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
                         ("type_evidence", "TEXT DEFAULT '{}'"),
                         ("targets_n", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
                         ("dry", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0")],
            "findings": [("blockers", "TEXT DEFAULT '[]'"), ("judged", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
                         ("eligible", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"), ("reward", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
                         ("poc_path", "TEXT DEFAULT ''"), ("tool", "TEXT")],
        }
        for table, cols in want.items():
            have = _cols(c, table)
            for name, decl in cols:
                if name not in have:
                    c.execute("ALTER TABLE %s ADD COLUMN %s %s" % (table, name, decl))


def _conn():
    c = getattr(_LOCAL, "c", None)
    if c is None:
        c = sqlite3.connect(DB, timeout=15, isolation_level=None)
        c.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
        c.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL")
        c.execute("PRAGMA synchronous=NORMAL")
        c.execute("PRAGMA busy_timeout=15000")
        _LOCAL.c = c
    return c


@contextmanager
def db():
    yield _conn()


def log(pid, line):
    line = str(line)[:4000]
    ts = time.time()
    slug = ""
    try:
        with db() as c:
            c.execute("INSERT INTO log(pid,ts,line) VALUES(?,?,?)", (pid, ts, line))
            r = c.execute("SELECT slug FROM projects WHERE id=?", (pid,)).fetchone()
            slug = (r["slug"] if r else "") or ""
    except Exception:
        pass
    try:
        LOGQ.put_nowait((slug, ts, line))
    except queue.Full:
        pass
    print("[%s] %s" % (pid, line), flush=True)


def log_writer():
    while not STOP.is_set():
        try:
            slug, ts, line = LOGQ.get(timeout=1.0)
        except queue.Empty:
            continue
        try:
            d = WORK / (slug or "0")
            d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            with (d / "log.txt").open("a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                f.write("%s %s\n" % (time.strftime("%H:%M:%S", time.localtime(ts)), line))
        except Exception:
            pass


def heartbeat():
    while not STOP.is_set():
        time.sleep(20)
        try:
            with RUN_LOCK:
                live = sorted(RUNNING.keys())
            with db() as c:
                t0 = time.time()
                c.execute("SELECT 1").fetchone()
                dbms = int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)
            log(0, "hb: %d live, queue %d, db %dms, net %.1fs, discover %s"
                % (len(live), JOBQ.qsize(), dbms, NET_TIME[0],
                   "on" if AUTO_DISCOVER else "off"))
        except Exception as ex:
            log(0, "hb: %s" % str(ex)[:120])


def _net_wait(host):
    gap = max(NET_GAP + NET_PENALTY[0], 0.0)
    end = time.time() + max(0.0, gap - (time.time() - max(NET_LAST[0],
                                                          HOST_LAST.get(host, 0.0))))
    while time.time() < end:
        if STOP.is_set():
            return
        time.sleep(min(0.2, max(0.0, end - time.time())))


def _penalise(code, retry=""):
    if code in (429, 503) or (code == 403 and retry):
        NET_PENALTY[0] = min(NET_MAX_PENALTY, max(NET_PENALTY[0] * 1.6, 1.5))
    else:
        NET_PENALTY[0] = max(0.0, NET_PENALTY[0] * 0.75)


def fetch_full(url, headers=None, timeout=30, data=None, method="GET"):
    host = urlparse(url).netloc
    with NET_LOCK:
        _net_wait(host)
        t0 = time.time()
        h = {"User-Agent": UA, "Accept": "*/*"}
        h.update(headers or {})
        code, body, hdrs, cookies = 0, "", {}, []
        try:
            import urllib.request
            req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers=h, data=data, method=method)
            with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=timeout) as r:
                code = r.status
                body = r.read(SCAN_BYTES).decode("utf-8", "replace")
                hdrs = {k.lower(): v for k, v in r.headers.items()}
                cookies = r.headers.get_all("Set-Cookie") or []
        except Exception as ex:
            code = getattr(ex, "code", 0) or 0
            eh = getattr(ex, "headers", None)
            if code and eh is not None:
                try:
                    body = ex.read(SCAN_BYTES).decode("utf-8", "replace")
                except Exception:
                    body = ""
                hdrs = {k.lower(): v for k, v in eh.items()}
                cookies = eh.get_all("Set-Cookie") or []
        finally:
            NET_LAST[0] = time.time()
            NET_TIME[0] += time.time() - t0
            HOST_LAST[host] = NET_LAST[0]
            _penalise(code, hdrs.get("retry-after", ""))
    return code, body, hdrs, cookies


def fetch(url, headers=None, timeout=45, data=None, method="GET"):
    code, body, hdrs, _ = fetch_full(url, headers=headers, timeout=timeout, data=data,
                                     method=method)
    if code >= 400 or not code:
        raise RuntimeError("HTTP %d" % code)
    return body


def gh(path, timeout=30):
    h = {"Accept": "application/vnd.github+json"}
    if PAT:
        h["Authorization"] = "Bearer " + PAT
    return fetch("https://api.github.com" + path, headers=h, timeout=timeout)


_SEL = {"totalAssets": "0x01e1d114", "totalSupply": "0x18160ddd", "decimals": "0x313ce567"}
_CHAIN = {}


def rpc(chain, method, params):
    url = RPC.get(chain)
    if not url:
        raise RuntimeError("no rpc for chain %s" % chain)
    body = json.dumps({"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": method, "params": params}).encode()
    raw = fetch(url, headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"}, data=body,
                method="POST", timeout=25)
    out = json.loads(raw)
    if "error" in out:
        raise RuntimeError(out["error"].get("message", "rpc error"))
    return out.get("result")


def chain_of(address):
    if address in _CHAIN:
        return _CHAIN[address]
    for chain in RPC:
        try:
            if rpc(chain, "eth_getCode", [address, "latest"]) not in (None, "0x"):
                _CHAIN[address] = chain
                return chain
        except Exception:
            continue
    return 0


def _uint(hexstr):
    if not hexstr or hexstr == "0x":
        return 0
    try:
        return int(hexstr, 16)
    except ValueError:
        return 0


def abi_of(chain, address):
    d = WORK / "abi"
    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    f = d / ("%s-%s.json" % (chain, address))
    if f.exists():
        try:
            return json.loads(f.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        except Exception:
            return []
    if not ETHERSCAN:
        return []
    try:
        raw = fetch("https://api.etherscan.io/v2/api?chainid=%d&module=contract&action=getabi"
                    "&address=%s&apikey=%s" % (chain, address, ETHERSCAN), timeout=25)
        j = json.loads(raw)
        abi = json.loads(j.get("result") or "[]") if j.get("status") == "1" else []
    except Exception:
        abi = []
    f.write_text(json.dumps(abi), encoding="utf-8")
    return abi


def fork_block(chain):
    if FORK_BLOCK:
        try:
            return int(FORK_BLOCK)
        except ValueError:
            pass
    try:
        latest = _uint(rpc(chain, "eth_blockNumber", []))
    except Exception:
        return 0
    return max(0, latest - FORK_OFFSET)


def census(pid):
    if not VALUE_CENSUS:
        return 0
    if not getp(pid):
        return 0
    targets = [t.get("address") for t in (load_conditions(pid).get("targets") or [])
               if t.get("address")]
    if not targets:
        return 0
    lines, total = [], 0
    for addr in targets[:40]:
        chain = chain_of(addr)
        if not chain:
            lines.append("%s  no code on configured chains" % addr)
            continue
        try:
            bal = _uint(rpc(chain, "eth_getBalance", [addr, "latest"]))
        except Exception as ex:
            lines.append("%s  balance error: %s" % (addr, ex))
            continue
        assets = supply = dec = 0
        names = {e.get("name") for e in abi_of(chain, addr) if e.get("type") == "function"}
        for fn in ("totalAssets", "totalSupply", "decimals"):
            if names and fn not in names:
                continue
            try:
                v = _uint(rpc(chain, "eth_call", [{"to": addr, "data": _SEL[fn]}, "latest"]))
            except Exception:
                v = 0
            if fn == "totalAssets":
                assets = v
            elif fn == "totalSupply":
                supply = v
            else:
                dec = v
        held = max(bal, assets)
        if supply and 0 < dec <= 36:
            held = max(held, supply * 10 ** (18 - dec) if dec < 18 else supply // (10 ** (dec - 18)))
        total += held
        eth = held / 1e18
        lines.append("%s  chain %d  native %.6f  assets %.6f  supply %d  -> %.6f ETH  $%.0f"
                     % (addr, chain, bal / 1e18, assets / 1e18, supply, eth, eth * ETH_USD))
        fb = fork_block(chain)
        if fb:
            lines.append("    fork: chain %d block %d" % (chain, fb))
    (project_dir(pid) / "value.txt").write_text("\n".join(lines), encoding="utf-8")
    setp(pid, tvl=total)
    log(pid, "census: %d target(s), %.6f ETH-eq, $%.0f"
        % (len(targets), total / 1e18, total / 1e18 * ETH_USD))
    return total


def add_project(url, name="", source="auto", toolchain="unknown", max_bounty=0, rank=50,
                manual_flag=0, details=0, locked=0):
    url = (url or "").strip()
    if not url:
        return 0
    with db() as c:
        r = c.execute("SELECT id FROM projects WHERE url=?", (url,)).fetchone()
        if r:
            c.execute("UPDATE projects SET updated=?, auto=1 WHERE id=?", (time.time(), r["id"]))
            return r["id"]
        nm = name or urlparse(url).netloc or url
        cur = c.execute(
            "INSERT INTO projects(url,name,status,stage,toolchain,max,rank,source,manual,"
            "details_ok,type_locked,added,updated) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
            (url, nm[:80], "new", "", toolchain, max_bounty, rank, source, manual_flag,
             details, locked, time.time(), time.time()))
        pid = cur.lastrowid
        c.execute("UPDATE projects SET slug=? WHERE id=?", (manual.slugify(nm, pid), pid))
    log(pid, "queued %s" % url)
    return pid


def setp(pid, **kw):
    if not kw:
        return
    kw["updated"] = time.time()
    cols = ", ".join("%s=?" % k for k in kw)
    with db() as c:
        c.execute("UPDATE projects SET %s WHERE id=?" % cols, (*kw.values(), pid))


def getp(pid):
    with db() as c:
        return c.execute("SELECT * FROM projects WHERE id=?", (pid,)).fetchone()


def running_pids():
    with RUN_LOCK:
        return set(RUNNING.keys())


def project_dir(pid):
    r = getp(pid)
    d = WORK / ((r["slug"] if r and r["slug"] else str(pid)))
    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    return d


def add_finding(pid, tool, title, sev, file="", line=0, evidence="", **kw):
    t = TOOLS.get(tool, {})
    base = SEV_W.get(sev, 14) + t.get("reward", 0) // 400
    proof = 8 if (line or ":" in (file or "")) else 0
    score = min(100, base + min(12, len(evidence) // 120) + proof)
    with db() as c:
        cur = c.execute(
            "INSERT INTO findings(pid,title,sev,cls,file,line,evidence,score,fund,reward,"
            "tool,ts) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
            (pid, title[:300], sev, t.get("cls", "logic"), file[:300], line,
             evidence[:20000], score, 1 if t.get("fund") else 0,
             kw.get("reward", 0), tool, time.time()))
        return cur.lastrowid


def findings(pid):
    with db() as c:
        return c.execute("SELECT * FROM findings WHERE pid=? ORDER BY score DESC",
                         (pid,)).fetchall()


def load_conditions(pid):
    f = project_dir(pid) / "contract.json"
    if not f.exists():
        return {}
    try:
        return json.loads(f.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except Exception:
        return {}


def parse_scope(pid, text=None):
    p = getp(pid)
    if not p:
        return {}
    d = project_dir(pid)
    fn = getattr(contract, "parse_program", None)
    if not fn:
        return {}
    tries = []
    if text is not None:
        tries = [lambda: fn(p["url"], d, text=text), lambda: fn(pid, d, text=text),
                 lambda: fn(p["url"], str(d), text)]
    else:
        tries = [lambda: fn(p["url"], d), lambda: fn(p["url"], str(d)),
                 lambda: fn(pid, d)]
    for t in tries:
        try:
            return t() or {}
        except TypeError:
            continue
        except Exception as ex:
            log(pid, "parse: %s" % ex)
            return {}
    return {}


def _blockers(f, pol):
    b = []
    ex = pol.get("exclusions") or {}
    surf = " ".join(ex.get("surfaces") or []).lower()
    for word in ("cdn", "third-party", "testnet", "mock"):
        if word in surf and word in (f["file"] or "").lower():
            b.append("out of scope: " + word)
    if (pol.get("poc") or {}).get("required") and not f["poc_path"]:
        b.append("poc required")
    for nv in ex.get("non_vulns") or []:
        head = nv.lower()[:24]
        if head and head in (f["title"] or "").lower():
            b.append("known non-vuln")
            break
    return b


def gate(pid):
    if not getp(pid):
        return
    pol = load_conditions(pid)
    rows = findings(pid)
    eligible = money = 0
    for f in rows:
        bl = _blockers(f, pol)
        ok = not bl and f["score"] >= THRESHOLD and f["sev"] != "info"
        with db() as c:
            c.execute("UPDATE findings SET blockers=?, judged=1, eligible=? WHERE id=?",
                      (json.dumps(bl), 1 if ok else 0, f["id"]))
        eligible += 1 if ok else 0
        money += 1 if (ok and f["fund"]) else 0
    score = int(100 * eligible / len(rows)) if rows else 0
    setp(pid, readiness=score, fund_hits=money)
    log(pid, "gate: %d findings, %d eligible, %d money, readiness %d"
        % (len(rows), eligible, money, score))


def _details_ok(pid):
    d = project_dir(pid)
    for name in ("details.json", "details.txt", "details.html"):
        f = d / name
        if f.exists() and f.stat().st_size > 200:
            return True
    return False


def step_intake(ctx):
    pid = ctx["pid"]
    p = getp(pid)
    if not p:
        return ctx
    if p["manual"]:
        ctx["details_ok"] = True
        log(pid, "intake: manual project, details gate bypassed")
    elif _details_ok(pid):
        if not p["details_ok"]:
            setp(pid, details_ok=1, status="ready")
        ctx["details_ok"] = True
        log(pid, "intake: details on disk")
    else:
        setp(pid, details_ok=0)
        log(pid, "intake: details missing, fetching %s" % p["url"])
        try:
            n = platforms.details(p["url"], project_dir(pid))
            setp(pid, details_ok=1, status="ready")
            ctx["details_ok"] = True
            log(pid, "intake: details saved, %s bytes" % n)
        except Exception as ex:
            setp(pid, status="needs-details")
            log(pid, "intake: details failed: %s" % ex)
    if not p["type_locked"] and p["toolchain"] in ("unknown", ""):
        try:
            tc, conf, ev = platforms.resolve_type(project_dir(pid), p["url"])
        except Exception as ex:
            tc, conf, ev = "unknown", "unresolved", {"reason": str(ex)}
        if tc != "unknown":
            setp(pid, toolchain=tc, type_conf=conf, type_evidence=json.dumps(ev)[:4000])
            log(pid, "intake: type %s (%s)" % (tc, conf))
        else:
            setp(pid, type_evidence=json.dumps(ev)[:4000])
    return ctx


def step_conditions(ctx):
    pid = ctx["pid"]
    existing = load_conditions(pid)
    if existing and existing.get("targets"):
        setp(pid, cond_ok=1, targets_n=len(existing.get("targets") or []))
        if VALUE_CENSUS and not (project_dir(pid) / "value.txt").exists():
            try:
                census(pid)
            except Exception as ex:
                log(pid, "census: %s" % ex)
        log(pid, "conditions: %d target(s) already parsed" % len(existing.get("targets") or []))
        return ctx
    pol = parse_scope(pid)
    if pol and pol.get("targets"):
        try:
            contract.save_conditions(pid, **pol)
        except Exception as ex:
            log(pid, "conditions: save failed: %s" % ex)
        n = len(pol.get("targets") or [])
        setp(pid, cond_ok=1, targets_n=n)
        log(pid, "conditions: %d targets, %d tiers" % (n, len(pol.get("severity") or [])))
        if VALUE_CENSUS:
            try:
                census(pid)
            except Exception as ex:
                log(pid, "census: %s" % ex)
        return ctx
    setp(pid, cond_ok=0, targets_n=0)
    log(pid, "conditions: nothing parsed, scan will use the url and saved text")
    return ctx


def step_brief(ctx):
    pid = ctx["pid"]
    pol = load_conditions(pid)
    ctx["brief"] = pol
    log(pid, "brief: scope %s, poc %s, %d target(s)"
        % (pol.get("scope_model") or "unknown", (pol.get("poc") or {}).get("required"),
           len(pol.get("targets") or [])))
    return ctx


ADDR_RE = re.compile(r"\b0x[a-fA-F0-9]{40}\b")
URL_RE = re.compile(r"https?://[\w.\-]+(?:/[\w./%\-?=&]*)?")


def collect_targets(pid):
    p = getp(pid)
    if not p:
        return []
    out = []

    def push(x):
        x = x.strip().rstrip(".,);]'\"")
        if x and x not in out:
            out.append(x)

    for t in (load_conditions(pid).get("targets") or []):
        if t.get("address"):
            push(t["address"])
    host = urlparse(p["url"]).netloc
    for name in ("details.txt", "details.html", "contract.json"):
        f = project_dir(pid) / name
        if not f.exists():
            continue
        try:
            txt = f.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")[:400000]
        except Exception:
            continue
        for m in ADDR_RE.finditer(txt):
            push(m.group(0))
        for m in URL_RE.finditer(txt):
            u = m.group(0)
            if "github.com" in u or urlparse(u).netloc == host:
                push(u)
    if p["url"].startswith("http"):
        push(p["url"])
    return out[:SCAN_TARGETS]
