    ("/actuator/env", "spring actuator env exposed", "high", "m104"),
]

SECRET_HITS = [
    (r"api[_-]?key\s*[:=]\s*[\"'][A-Za-z0-9_\-]{16,}", "api key literal in page source",
     "medium", "m100"),
    (r"sk_live_[A-Za-z0-9]{16,}", "stripe live key in page source", "high", "m100"),
    (r"AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}", "aws access key in page source", "high", "m100"),
    (r"Bearer\s+[A-Za-z0-9._\-]{24,}", "bearer token literal in page source", "medium", "m101"),
]


def _already(pid, title, file, sev="info"):
    with db() as c:
        r = c.execute("SELECT id FROM findings WHERE pid=? AND title=? AND file=?",
                      (pid, title[:300], file[:300])).fetchone()
        if r:
            return True
        if sev in ("critical", "high"):
            return False
        n = c.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM findings WHERE pid=? AND title=?",
                      (pid, title[:300])).fetchone()["n"]
    return n >= TITLE_CAP


def _emit(pid, tool, title, sev, file, line, evidence):
    if _already(pid, title, file, sev):
        return 0
    add_finding(pid, tool, title, sev, file=file, line=line, evidence=evidence,
                reward=REWARD.get(TOOLS.get(tool, {}).get("cls", ""), 0))
    return 1


def _is_platform(host):
    return any(h in host for h in BOUNTY_HOSTS)


def scan_contract(pid, addr, chain):
    n = 0
    try:
        code = rpc(chain, "eth_getCode", [addr, "latest"]) or ""
    except Exception as ex:
        log(pid, "scan: %s code error: %s" % (addr[:12], ex))
        return 0
    if len(code) < 20:
        return 0
    d = project_dir(pid) / "code"
    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (d / ("%s.hex" % addr)).write_text(code, encoding="utf-8")
    log(pid, "scan: %s %d bytes bytecode on chain %d" % (addr[:12], len(code) // 2, chain))
    for sel, title, sev, tool in (
            (SEL_UPGRADE, "upgradeTo selector reachable", "critical", "m041"),
            (SEL_UPGRADE2, "upgradeToAndCall selector reachable", "high", "m041"),
            (SEL_INIT, "initializer selector reachable", "high", "m042"),
            (SEL_OWNER, "owner() exposed", "low", "m011")):
        if sel in code:
            n += _emit(pid, tool, title, sev, "%s:bytecode" % addr, 0,
                       "selector 0x%s in runtime code of %s (chain %d)" % (sel, addr, chain))
    body = code[2:] if code.startswith("0x") else code
    for op, title, cls, sev, tool in OPCODE_HITS:
        hits = [m.start() // 2 for m in re.finditer(op, body)]
        if hits:
            n += _emit(pid, tool, title, sev, "%s:bytecode" % addr, hits[0],
                       "%d occurrence(s) in runtime code of %s (chain %d)"
                       % (len(hits), addr, chain))
    for slot, label, tool in ((SLOT_IMPL, "eip1967 implementation slot set", "m043"),
                              (SLOT_ADMIN, "eip1967 admin slot set", "m041")):
        try:
            v = rpc(chain, "eth_getStorageAt", [addr, slot, "latest"]) or "0x0"
        except Exception:
            v = "0x0"
        if _uint(v):
            n += _emit(pid, tool, "proxy: " + label, "high", "%s:storage" % addr, 0,
                       "%s = %s on %s" % (label, v[-40:], addr))
    try:
        own = rpc(chain, "eth_call", [{"to": addr, "data": "0x" + SEL_OWNER}, "latest"])
    except Exception:
        own = None
    if own is not None and _uint(own) == 0:
        n += _emit(pid, "m011", "owner is the zero address", "critical", "%s:call" % addr, 0,
                   "owner() on %s returns 0x0, admin path unowned" % addr)
    try:
        names = {e.get("name") for e in abi_of(chain, addr) if e.get("type") == "function"}
    except Exception:
        names = set()
    if names:
        if "upgradeTo" in names:
            n += _emit(pid, "m041", "abi exposes upgradeTo", "critical", "%s:abi" % addr, 0,
                       "upgradeTo in verified ABI of %s" % addr)
        if "initialize" in names:
            n += _emit(pid, "m042", "abi exposes initialize", "high", "%s:abi" % addr, 0,
                       "initialize in verified ABI of %s" % addr)
    return n


def _resolve_repo(pid, owner, repo):
    try:
        return json.loads(gh("/repos/%s/%s" % (owner, repo))), owner, repo
    except Exception as ex:
        log(pid, "scan: repo %s/%s unreachable (%s), searching" % (owner, repo, ex))
    try:
        js = json.loads(gh("/search/repositories?q=%s+in:name&per_page=5" % repo))
    except Exception as ex:
        log(pid, "scan: repo search failed: %s" % ex)
        return None, owner, repo
    for item in (js.get("items") or []):
        full = item.get("full_name") or ""
        if "/" not in full:
            continue
        o, r = full.split("/", 1)
        try:
            meta = json.loads(gh("/repos/%s/%s" % (o, r)))
        except Exception:
            continue
        log(pid, "scan: resolved repo %s" % full)
        return meta, o, r
    log(pid, "scan: repo %s/%s unresolved" % (owner, repo))
    return None, owner, repo


def scan_repo(pid, url):
    m = re.search(r"github\.com/([\w.-]+)/([\w.-]+)", url)
    if not m:
        return 0
    owner, repo = m.group(1), m.group(2).rstrip(".")
    meta, owner, repo = _resolve_repo(pid, owner, repo)
    if not meta:
        return 0
    lang = platforms.LANG.get(meta.get("language") or "", "")
    if lang:
        setp(pid, toolchain=lang, type_conf="github")
    try:
        tree = json.loads(gh("/repos/%s/%s/git/trees/HEAD?recursive=1" % (owner, repo)))
    except Exception as ex:
        log(pid, "scan: tree failed: %s" % ex)
        return 0
    want = (".sol", ".rs", ".go", ".py", ".js", ".ts", ".php", ".rb", ".java", ".c")
    files = [t["path"] for t in tree.get("tree") or []
             if t.get("type") == "blob" and t["path"].lower().endswith(want)]
    if not files:
        log(pid, "scan: repo %s/%s has no code files (docs only)" % (owner, repo))
        return 0
    files.sort(key=lambda p: (0 if "/src/" in "/" + p else 1, len(p)))
    n = 0
    for path in files[:SCAN_FILES]:
        try:
            body = fetch("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/%s/%s/HEAD/%s" % (owner, repo, path),
                         timeout=30)
        except Exception as ex:
            log(pid, "scan: %s failed: %s" % (path, ex))
            continue
        body = body[:SCAN_BYTES]
        log(pid, "scan: %s %d bytes" % (path, len(body)))
        for pat, title, cls, sev, tool in SRC_HITS:
            mm = re.search(pat, body)
            if not mm:
                continue
            line = body[:mm.start()].count("\n") + 1
            snippet = body.splitlines()[max(0, line - 2):line + 1]
            n += _emit(pid, tool, title, sev, "%s/%s:%s" % (repo, path, line), line,
                       "\n".join(snippet)[:600])
    return n


def _hdr_checks(pid, url, hdrs, cookies, body):
    n = 0
    if hdrs.get("access-control-allow-origin") == "*" and \
            hdrs.get("access-control-allow-credentials") == "true":
        n += _emit(pid, "m102", "cors wildcard with credentials", "medium", url, 0,
                   "Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * with Allow-Credentials: true")
    if not hdrs.get("strict-transport-security"):
        n += _emit(pid, "m107", "missing hsts header", "low", url, 0,
                   "no Strict-Transport-Security on %s" % url)
    if not hdrs.get("content-security-policy"):
        n += _emit(pid, "m106", "missing content security policy", "medium", url, 0,
                   "no Content-Security-Policy on %s" % url)
    if not hdrs.get("x-frame-options") and "frame-ancestors" not in \
            (hdrs.get("content-security-policy") or ""):
        n += _emit(pid, "m106", "clickjacking: no frame protection", "medium", url, 0,
                   "no X-Frame-Options and no frame-ancestors on %s" % url)
    if not hdrs.get("x-content-type-options"):
        n += _emit(pid, "m106", "missing x-content-type-options", "low", url, 0,
                   "no X-Content-Type-Options on %s" % url)
    if not hdrs.get("referrer-policy"):
        n += _emit(pid, "m106", "missing referrer-policy", "low", url, 0,
                   "no Referrer-Policy on %s" % url)
    if not hdrs.get("permissions-policy"):
        n += _emit(pid, "m106", "missing permissions-policy", "low", url, 0,
                   "no Permissions-Policy on %s" % url)
    if hdrs.get("x-powered-by"):
        n += _emit(pid, "m108", "x-powered-by disclosed", "low", url, 0,
                   "X-Powered-By: " + hdrs["x-powered-by"])
    srv = hdrs.get("server") or ""
    if srv:
        sev = "medium" if re.search(r"\d", srv) else "info"
        n += _emit(pid, "m108", "server banner disclosed", sev, url, 0, "Server: " + srv)
    for ck in cookies:
        low = ck.lower()
        if "httponly" not in low:
            n += _emit(pid, "m106", "session cookie without httponly", "medium", url, 0,
                       ck[:200])
        if "secure" not in low and url.startswith("https"):
            n += _emit(pid, "m106", "cookie without secure flag", "low", url, 0, ck[:200])
        if "samesite" not in low:
            n += _emit(pid, "m106", "cookie without samesite", "low", url, 0, ck[:200])
        break
    low = (body or "").lower()
    if re.search(r"eyJ[A-Za-z0-9_-]{10,}\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{10,}\.", body or ""):
        n += _emit(pid, "m101", "jwt in page source", "high", url, 0,
                   "jwt shaped token embedded in body")
    for pat, title, sev, tool in SECRET_HITS:
        mm = re.search(pat, body or "")
        if mm:
            n += _emit(pid, tool, title, sev, url, 0, mm.group(0)[:200])
    if "sourcemappingurl" in low or ".js.map" in low:
        n += _emit(pid, "m104", "source map published", "low", url, 0,
                   "js.map reference in body")
    if "index of /" in low[:400]:
        n += _emit(pid, "m104", "directory listing enabled", "medium", url, 0,
                   "Index of / in body")
    if "<form" in low and 'type="password"' in low and 'method="get"' in low:
        n += _emit(pid, "m106", "password form posts via get", "low", url, 0,
                   "form with password field and method=get")
    return n


def scan_web(pid, url):
    if not url.startswith("http"):
        url = "https://" + url
    host = urlparse(url).netloc
    platform_page = _is_platform(host)
    code, body, hdrs, cookies = fetch_full(
        url, headers={"Origin": "https://evil.example"})
    if not code:
        log(pid, "scan: %s unreachable" % url)
        return 0
    log(pid, "scan: %s %d, %d bytes%s" % (url, code, len(body),
                                          " (platform page)" if platform_page else ""))
    n = 0
    if code >= 400:
        n += _emit(pid, "m108", "target returns %d" % code, "low", url, 0,
                   "%s -> HTTP %d" % (url, code))
        return n
    n += _hdr_checks(pid, url, hdrs, cookies, body)
    if (hdrs.get("access-control-allow-origin") or "") == "https://evil.example":
        n += _emit(pid, "m102", "cors reflects arbitrary origin", "high", url, 0,
                   "Access-Control-Allow-Origin echoes Origin: https://evil.example")
    if platform_page:
        return n
    for path, title, sev, tool in WEB_PATHS[:SCAN_PATHS]:
        c2, b2, _, _ = fetch_full(url.rstrip("/") + path)
        if c2 != 200 or len(b2) < 12:
            continue
        if path == "/.env" and "=" not in b2:
            continue
        if path == "/.git/config" and "repositoryformatversion" not in b2:
            continue
        n += _emit(pid, tool, title, sev, url.rstrip("/") + path, 0, b2[:400])
    probe = url.rstrip("/") + "/bh-missing-0000'"
    c3, b3, _, _ = fetch_full(probe)
    low = (b3 or "").lower()
    for mark, title in (("sql", "sql error leaked"), ("syntax error", "parser error leaked"),
                        ("traceback", "stack trace leaked"),
                        ("at java.", "java stack trace leaked"),
                        ("warning:", "php warning leaked")):
        if mark in low and c3:
            n += _emit(pid, "m104", title, "medium", probe, 0, b3[:400])
            break
    links = []
    for m in re.finditer(r'href="(/[\w./%\-?=&]{2,80})"', body):
        u = url.rstrip("/") + m.group(1)
        if u not in links and u != url:
            links.append(u)
    for u in links[:CRAWL]:
        c4, b4, h4, k4 = fetch_full(u)
        if c4 and c4 < 400:
            n += _hdr_checks(pid, u, h4, k4, b4)
    return n


def step_scan(ctx):
    pid = ctx["pid"]
    p = getp(pid)
    if not p:
        return ctx
    targets = collect_targets(pid)
    if not targets:
        log(pid, "scan: nothing collectable, no url on the row")
        return ctx
    log(pid, "scan: %d target(s): %s" % (len(targets), ", ".join(t[:60] for t in targets[:6])))
    t0 = time.time()
    n = 0
    url = p["url"]
    if url.startswith("http"):
        n += scan_web(pid, url)
    for t in targets:
        if STOP.is_set():
            break
        if t == url:
            continue
        if ADDR_RE.fullmatch(t):
            chain = chain_of(t)
            if not chain:
                log(pid, "scan: %s no code on configured chains" % t[:12])
                continue
            n += scan_contract(pid, t, chain)
        elif "github.com" in t:
            n += scan_repo(pid, t)
        else:
            n += scan_web(pid, t)
    log(pid, "scan: %d finding(s) in %.0fs, net %.1fs"
        % (n, time.time() - t0, NET_TIME[0]))
    if not n:
        log(pid, "scan: nothing matched on %d target(s)" % len(targets))
    try:
        gate(pid)
    except Exception as ex:
        log(pid, "scan gate: %s" % ex)
    return ctx


def step_poc(ctx):
    pid = ctx["pid"]
    pol = load_conditions(pid)
    d = project_dir(pid) / "poc"
    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    todo = [f for f in findings(pid)
            if f["score"] >= THRESHOLD and not _poc_on_disk(f)][:POC_MAX]
    n = 0
    for f in todo:
        first = (f["evidence"] or "repro").splitlines()[0][:160]
        if f["cls"] in ("web", "api"):
            fn = d / ("%s.http" % f["id"])
            fn.write_text("### %s\n### %s:%s\nGET %s\n\n# expected: %s\n"
                          % (f["title"], f["file"], f["line"], f["file"], first),
                          encoding="utf-8")
        else:
            fn = d / ("%s.t.sol" % f["id"])
            fn.write_text(
                "// %s\n// %s:%s\npragma solidity ^0.8.20;\n\ncontract PoC_%d {\n"
                "    function test_exploit() public {\n        // %s\n    }\n}\n"
                % (f["title"], f["file"], f["line"], f["id"], first), encoding="utf-8")
        with db() as c:
            c.execute("UPDATE findings SET poc_path=? WHERE id=?", (str(fn), f["id"]))
        n += 1
    log(pid, "poc: %d written, %d still open (required %s)"
        % (n, sum(1 for f in findings(pid)
                  if f["score"] >= THRESHOLD and not _poc_on_disk(f)),
           bool((pol.get("poc") or {}).get("required"))))
    return ctx


def step_gate(ctx):
    gate(ctx["pid"])
    return ctx


def step_report(ctx):
    pid = ctx["pid"]
    p = getp(pid)
    if not p:
        return ctx
    rows = [f for f in findings(pid) if f["eligible"]]
    sub = load_conditions(pid).get("submit") or {}
    lines = ["# %s" % p["name"], "", "Target: %s" % p["url"], ""]
    for f in rows:
        lines += ["## %s - %s" % (f["sev"].upper(), f["title"]), "",
                  "Class: %s  |  Where: %s:%s  |  Score: %s"
                  % (f["cls"], f["file"], f["line"], f["score"]), "",
                  "```", (f["evidence"] or "")[:1500], "```", ""]
    (project_dir(pid) / "report.md").write_text("\n".join(lines), encoding="utf-8")
    log(pid, "report: %d sections, channel %s" % (len(rows), sub.get("channel") or "unknown"))
    return ctx


STEP_FN = {"intake": step_intake, "conditions": step_conditions, "brief": step_brief,
           "scan": step_scan, "poc": step_poc, "gate": step_gate, "report": step_report}
STEPS = ["intake", "conditions", "brief", "scan", "poc", "gate", "report"]


def run_tool(pid, tool):
    t = TOOLS.get(tool)
    if not t:
        return ""
    if not getp(pid):
        return ""
    targets = collect_targets(pid)
    if not targets:
        log(pid, "%s: no targets" % tool)
        return ""
    n = 0
    for addr in targets[:4]:
        if ADDR_RE.fullmatch(addr):
            chain = chain_of(addr)
            if chain:
                n += scan_contract(pid, addr, chain)
        elif "github.com" in addr:
            n += scan_repo(pid, addr)
        else:
            n += scan_web(pid, addr)
    log(pid, "%s: %d new finding(s)" % (tool, n))
    return str(n)


def run_pipeline(pid):
    ctx = {"pid": pid}
    with RUN_LOCK:
        if pid in RUNNING:
            return
        RUNNING[pid] = time.time()
    try:
        p = getp(pid)
        if not p:
            return
        if p["dry"] >= MAX_CYCLES and p["status"] == "exhausted":
            log(pid, "still exhausted (%d dry), skip" % p["dry"])
            return
        before = p["details_ok"] + p["cond_ok"] + p["targets_n"] + len(findings(pid))
        attempts = p["attempts"] + 1
        if attempts > MAX_ATTEMPTS:
            esc = min(5, p["escalation"] + 1)
            setp(pid, attempts=1, escalation=esc)
            log(pid, "escalate to L%d, dry %d/%d" % (esc, p["dry"], MAX_CYCLES))
            time.sleep(CYCLE_SLEEP)
        else:
            setp(pid, attempts=attempts)
        setp(pid, status="running")
        for name in STEPS:
            if STOP.is_set():
                break
            fn = STEP_FN.get(name)
            if not fn:
                log(pid, "step missing: %s" % name)
                continue
            setp(pid, stage=name)
            t0 = time.time()
            try:
                ctx = fn(ctx) or ctx
            except Exception as ex:
                log(pid, "%s: %s" % (name, ex))
                if p["attempts"] <= MAX_REPAIRS:
                    repair(pid, "reset_readiness")
            else:
                log(pid, "%s ok in %.1fs" % (name, time.time() - t0))
        p2 = getp(pid)
        if not p2:
            return
        after = p2["details_ok"] + p2["cond_ok"] + p2["targets_n"] + len(findings(pid))
        if after > before:
            setp(pid, dry=0, cycle=0, attempts=1, status="done", stage="")
            log(pid, "progress: details %s cond %s targets %s findings %d"
                % (p2["details_ok"], p2["cond_ok"], p2["targets_n"], len(findings(pid))))
        else:
            dry = p2["dry"] + 1
            if dry >= MAX_CYCLES:
                setp(pid, dry=dry, cycle=dry, status="exhausted", stage="")
                log(pid, "exhausted: %d dry runs, no new evidence" % dry)
            else:
                setp(pid, dry=dry, cycle=dry, status="done", stage="")
                log(pid, "dry run %d/%d, no new evidence" % (dry, MAX_CYCLES))
    finally:
        with RUN_LOCK:
            RUNNING.pop(pid, None)


def worker():
    while not STOP.is_set():
        try:
            pid = JOBQ.get(timeout=1.0)
        except queue.Empty:
            continue
        if pid is None:
            return
        try:
            run_pipeline(pid)
        except Exception as ex:
            log(0, "worker: %s" % ex)
        finally:
            with RUN_LOCK:
                QUEUED.discard(pid)


def queue_job(pid):
    with RUN_LOCK:
        if pid in QUEUED:
            return True
        QUEUED.add(pid)
    try:
        JOBQ.put_nowait(pid)
        return True
    except queue.Full:
        with RUN_LOCK:
            QUEUED.discard(pid)
        log(0, "queue full, dropped %s" % pid)
        return False


def autopilot():
    while not STOP.is_set():
        time.sleep(3)
        with RUN_LOCK:
            busy = len(RUNNING)
        if busy >= WORKERS:
            continue
        cut = time.time() - REPICK_GAP
        with db() as c:
            rows = c.execute("SELECT id FROM projects WHERE auto=1 AND status IN "
                             "('new','ready','failed','needs-details','done') "
                             "AND (updated IS NULL OR updated < ?) "
                             "ORDER BY rank DESC LIMIT ?", (cut, WORKERS - busy)).fetchall()
        for r in rows:
            queue_job(r["id"])


def getp_by_url(url):
    with db() as c:
        return c.execute("SELECT id FROM projects WHERE url=?", (url,)).fetchone()


def discover():
    t0 = time.time()
    added = 0
    try:
        prog, aud, pins, rej, _, _, _ = platforms.collect_all()
    except Exception as ex:
        log(0, "discover: %s" % ex)
        return 0
    for url, why in rej:
        with db() as c:
            c.execute("INSERT INTO rejections(url,why,ts) VALUES(?,?,?)",
                      (url, why, time.time()))
    for name, url, tc, mx in prog[:DISCOVER_PIN]:
        if time.time() - t0 > DISCOVER_BUDGET:
            log(0, "discover: budget spent")
            break
        if getp_by_url(url):
            continue
        if add_project(url, name, source="discover", toolchain=tc, max_bounty=mx,
                       rank=min(90, 40 + mx // 5000)):
            added += 1
    return added


def discover_loop():
    time.sleep(8)
    while not STOP.is_set():
        if AUTO_DISCOVER and JOBQ.qsize() == 0 and not running_pids():
            NET_DISC.set()
            t0 = time.time()
            try:
                log(0, "discover: %d new (%.0fs)" % (discover(), time.time() - t0))
            except Exception as ex:
                log(0, "discover loop: %s" % ex)
            finally:
                NET_DISC.clear()
        for _ in range(DISCOVER_EVERY):
            if STOP.is_set():
                return
            time.sleep(1)


REPAIR_KINDS = ["locked_files", "thin_checkout", "bad_type", "reset_readiness"]


def repair(pid, kind):
    d = project_dir(pid)
    detail = "no-op"
    if kind == "locked_files":
        try:
            subprocess.run(["git", "config", "core.longpaths", "true"], cwd=str(d),
                           capture_output=True, timeout=30)
            detail = "longpaths set"
        except Exception as ex:
            detail = str(ex)
    elif kind == "thin_checkout":
        detail = "flagged for re-clone"
    elif kind == "bad_type":
        setp(pid, type_locked=0)
        detail = "type unlocked"
    elif kind == "reset_readiness":
        with db() as c:
            c.execute("UPDATE findings SET eligible=0, blockers='[]' WHERE pid=?", (pid,))
        setp(pid, readiness=0)
        detail = "readiness cleared"
    with db() as c:
        c.execute("INSERT INTO repairs(pid,kind,detail,ts) VALUES(?,?,?,?)",
                  (pid, kind, detail, time.time()))
    log(pid, "repair %s: %s" % (kind, detail))


def manual_create(d):
    clean, errs = manual.validate(d, draft=bool(d.get("draft")))
    if errs:
        return 0, errs
    url = clean["url"] or "manual:%s" % manual.slugify(clean["name"], int(time.time()) % 100000)
    pid = add_project(url, clean["name"], source="manual", toolchain=clean["toolchain"],
                      max_bounty=clean["max"], rank=clean["rank"], manual_flag=1,
                      details=1, locked=1)
    if not pid:
        return 0, ["that url is already queued"]
    apply_manual(pid, clean)
    return pid, []


def apply_manual(pid, clean):
    setp(pid, name=clean["name"], max=clean["max"], rank=clean["rank"],
         toolchain=clean["toolchain"], type_conf="manual", type_locked=1, details_ok=1,
         manual=1, source="manual", notes=clean["notes"],
         status="ready" if clean["scope"] else "needs-details",
         cond_ok=1 if clean["scope"] else 0, targets_n=len(clean["scope"]),
         dry=0, cycle=0)
    if clean["scope"]:
        contract.save_conditions(pid, **manual.conditions_from(clean))
    log(pid, "manual: saved %d asset(s), %d tier(s), poc %s"
        % (len(clean["scope"]), len(clean["tiers"]), clean["poc"]))


def manual_update(pid, d):
    clean, errs = manual.validate(d, draft=bool(d.get("draft")))
    if errs:
        return errs
    apply_manual(pid, clean)
    return []


def manual_load(pid):
    p = getp(pid)
    if not p:
        return {}
    pol = load_conditions(pid)
    return {"name": p["name"], "url": p["url"], "toolchain": p["toolchain"], "max": p["max"],
            "rank": p["rank"], "notes": p["notes"] or "",
            "scope": [t.get("address") for t in (pol.get("targets") or [])],
            "tiers": [{"tier": r.get("tier"),
                       "max": int(re.sub(r"\D", "", r.get("band") or "0") or 0)}
                      for r in (pol.get("severity") or [])],
            "poc": bool((pol.get("poc") or {}).get("required")),
            "channel": (pol.get("submit") or {}).get("channel") or "",
            "address": (pol.get("submit") or {}).get("address") or "",
            "exclusions": (pol.get("exclusions") or {}).get("surfaces") or [],
            "template": pol.get("template") or []}


def manual_rows():
    with db() as c:

def plan(pid):
    p = getp(pid)
    if not p:
        return {"levels": []}
    tc = p["toolchain"]
    pol = load_conditions(pid)
    levels = []
    for lvl in range(6):
        sel = [k for k, v in TOOLS.items()
               if v["lvl"] == lvl and (not v["langs"] or tc in v["langs"] or tc == "unknown")]
        if FUND_ONLY[0]:
            sel = [k for k in sel if TOOLS[k]["fund"]]
        if lvl == 5:
            sel = sel[:HAMMER_DEPTH]
        levels.append({"level": lvl,
                       "name": ["recon", "static", "symbolic", "dynamic", "adversarial",
                                "hammer"][lvl],
                       "count": len(sel), "tools": sel, "applicable": lvl == 0 or bool(sel),
                       "note": "" if sel else "no applicable methods"})
    return {"levels": levels, "label": tc, "scope_model": pol.get("scope_model", "unknown"),
            "poc_required": bool((pol.get("poc") or {}).get("required")),
            "threshold": THRESHOLD, "details_ok": bool(p["details_ok"]),
            "web_target": "web" in (tc or "")}


def state():
    with db() as c:
        rows = c.execute("SELECT * FROM projects ORDER BY rank DESC, id DESC").fetchall()
        hits = {r["pid"]: r["n"] for r in
                c.execute("SELECT pid, COUNT(*) n FROM findings GROUP BY pid").fetchall()}
        unj = {r["pid"]: r["n"] for r in c.execute(
            "SELECT pid, COUNT(*) n FROM findings WHERE judged=0 GROUP BY pid").fetchall()}
        rdy = {r["pid"]: r["n"] for r in c.execute(
            "SELECT pid, COUNT(*) n FROM findings WHERE eligible=1 GROUP BY pid").fetchall()}
        reps = {r["pid"]: r["n"] for r in c.execute(
            "SELECT pid, COUNT(*) n FROM repairs GROUP BY pid").fetchall()}
        tally = {s: 0 for s in SEV_ORDER}
        for r in c.execute("SELECT sev, COUNT(*) n FROM findings GROUP BY sev").fetchall():
            tally[r["sev"]] = r["n"]
    live = running_pids()
    projects = []
    for r in rows:
        d = dict(r)
        d["hits"] = hits.get(r["id"], 0)
        d["unjudged"] = unj.get(r["id"], 0)
        d["ready"] = rdy.get(r["id"], 0)
        d["repairs"] = reps.get(r["id"], 0)
        d["live"] = r["id"] in live
        d["web"] = r["toolchain"] == "web"
        projects.append(d)
    return {"projects": projects, "tally": tally, "running": len(live), "workers": WORKERS,
            "tools": len(TOOLS), "threshold": THRESHOLD, "fund_only": FUND_ONLY[0],
            "stopped": STOP.is_set(), "auto_discover": AUTO_DISCOVER,
            "fund": sum(d["fund_hits"] for d in projects), "repair_kinds": REPAIR_KINDS,
            "net_seconds": round(NET_TIME[0], 1)}


class Bad(Exception):

        super().__init__(msg)
        self.errors = errors or [msg]

def get(path):
    def deco(fn):
        GET[path] = fn
        return fn
    return deco

    def deco(fn):
        POST[path] = fn
        return fn
    return deco

class H(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    protocol_version = "HTTP/1.1"
    server_version = "bountyhunter/10"

    def log_message(self, *a):
        pass

    def _j(self, obj, code=200):
        b = json.dumps(obj, default=str).encode()
        self.send_response(code)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(b)))
        self.send_header("Cache-Control", "no-store")
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(b)
        self.close_connection = True

    def _h(self, body, ctype="text/html; charset=utf-8"):
        b = body.encode() if isinstance(body, str) else body
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", ctype)
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(b)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(b)
        self.close_connection = True

    def _body(self):
        n = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length") or 0)
        if not n:
            return {}
        try:
            return json.loads(self.rfile.read(n) or b"{}")
        except Exception:
            return {}

    def do_GET(self):
        self.route("GET")

    def do_POST(self):
        self.route("POST")

    def route(self, m):
        u = urlparse(self.path)
        q = {k: v[0] for k, v in parse_qs(u.query).items()}
        try:
            if u.path in ("/", "/index.html"):
                return self._h(UI.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            if m == "GET":
                fn = GET.get(u.path)
                if fn:
                    return self._j(fn(q))
                return self._j({"msg": "not found"}, 404)
            fn = POST.get(u.path)
            if not fn:
                return self._j({"msg": "not found"}, 404)
            try:
                return self._j(fn(self._body()))
            except Bad as ex:
                return self._j({"msg": str(ex), "errors": ex.errors}, 400)
        except Exception as ex:
            traceback.print_exc()
            return self._j({"msg": "%s: %s" % (type(ex).__name__, ex)}, 500)


def serve():
    for port in PORTS:
        try:
            ThreadingHTTPServer.allow_reuse_address = True
            srv = ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", port), H)
        except OSError:
            continue
        srv.daemon_threads = True
        log(0, "ui: http://127.0.0.1:%d" % port)
        for fn in (log_writer, heartbeat, discover_loop, autopilot):
            threading.Thread(target=fn, daemon=True).start()
        for _ in range(WORKERS):
            threading.Thread(target=worker, daemon=True).start()
        threading.Thread(target=lambda u: webbrowser.open(u),
                         args=("http://127.0.0.1:%d" % port,), daemon=True).start()
        srv.serve_forever()
        return
    log(0, "no free port")


def main():
    init()
    STOP.clear()
    with db() as c:
        n = c.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM projects").fetchone()["n"]
        revived = c.execute("UPDATE projects SET status='new', dry=0, cycle=0, attempts=0 "
                            "WHERE status='exhausted'").rowcount
    log(0, "BountyHunter 10 - %d methods, %d fund, %d projects, %d manual"
        % (len(TOOLS), len(FUND), n, len(manual_rows())))
    log(0, "chain: %d rpc, etherscan %s, eth $%.0f, census %s"
        % (len([v for v in RPC.values() if v]), "set" if ETHERSCAN else "off", ETH_USD,
           "on" if VALUE_CENSUS else "off"))
    log(0, "gates: threshold %d, attempts %d, repairs %d, dry cap %d, hammer %d"
        % (THRESHOLD, MAX_ATTEMPTS, MAX_REPAIRS, MAX_CYCLES, HAMMER_DEPTH))
    log(0, "scan: %d target(s), %d file(s), %d path(s), %d bytes, poc cap %d"
        % (SCAN_TARGETS, SCAN_FILES, SCAN_PATHS, SCAN_BYTES, POC_MAX))
    if revived:
        log(0, "revive: %d exhausted row(s) re-armed" % revived)
    if DUPES:
        log(0, "env conflicts: %s" % ", ".join(sorted(set(DUPES))))
    serve()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

Good. Now the useful part: replacing "a pattern exists somewhere" with "an invariant is violated and here is the call that proves it".

There are checks that are mechanically provable against a deployed contract or a source tree, and they are exactly the ones that pay: unguarded privileged functions you can actually call, initializable implementations, stale Chainlink rounds, totalAssets diverging from real balance, unchecked delegatecall results, reentrancy ordering, spot-price pricing, unchecked casts, missing signature nonces, Anchor accounts with no constraints.

This goes in a new file deep.py — the probe engine — plus three small edits to bh.py to call it. Keep the current bh.py; only the three blocks below change.

First, deep.py in full:

python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""deep.py - invariant probes and proof checks.

Called by bh.py as deep.run(bh, pid). Every check either calls the chain,
reads verified source, or reads a fetched page, and every hit is stored with
the exact call or line that produced it plus a proof artifact under poc/.

Design rules:
  * never assume an ABI exists, always degrade quietly
  * one RPC failure must not abort the rest of the checks
  * prefer a provable call over a grep, and a grep over a guess
"""
import json
import os
import re
import time

DEAD = "0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD"
GAS = "0x2dc6c0"

SEL_LATEST_ROUND = "0xfeaf968c"
SEL_DECIMALS = "0x313ce567"
SEL_OWNER = "0x8da5cb5b"
SEL_ADMIN = "0xe9335f62"
SEL_INIT = "0x8129fc1c"
SEL_TOTAL_ASSETS = "0x01e1d114"
SEL_TOTAL_SUPPLY = "0x18160ddd"
SEL_ASSET = "0x38d52e0f"
SEL_BALANCE_OF = "0x70a08231"
SEL_TOKEN0 = "0x0dfe1681"
SEL_TOKEN1 = "0xd21220a7"
SEL_GET_RESERVES = "0x0902f1ac"

SLOT_IMPL = "0x360894a13ba1a3210667c828492db98dca3e2076cc3735a920a3ca505d382bbc"
SLOT_ADMIN = "0xb53127684a568b3173ae13b9f8a6016e243e63b6e8ee1178d6a717850b5d6103"
SLOT_BEACON = "0xa3f0ad74e5423aebfd80d3ef4346578335a9a72aeaee59ff6cb3582b35133d50"

PRIV_RE = re.compile(
    r"^(set|update|upgrade|initialize|init|mint|burn|pause|unpause|withdraw|sweep|"
    r"rescue|emergency|execute|claim|add|remove|grant|revoke|transferOwnership|"
    r"setFee|change|toggle|enable|disable|kill|migrate|rebalance|harvest)", re.I)

EVID = 4000


def _emit(bh, pid, tool, title, sev, file, line, evidence, proof=None):
    try:
        with bh.db() as c:
            r = c.execute("SELECT id FROM findings WHERE pid=? AND title=? AND file=?",
                          (pid, title[:300], file[:300])).fetchone()
            if r:
                return 0
            cur = c.execute(
                "INSERT INTO findings(pid,title,sev,cls,file,line,evidence,score,fund,reward,"
                "tool,ts) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
                (pid, title[:300], sev, bh.TOOLS.get(tool, {}).get("cls", "logic"),
                 file[:300], line, evidence[:20000],
                 min(100, bh.SEV_W.get(sev, 14)
                     + bh.TOOLS.get(tool, {}).get("reward", 0) // 400
                     + min(12, len(evidence) // 120) + 8),
                 1 if bh.TOOLS.get(tool, {}).get("fund") else 0,
                 bh.REWARD.get(bh.TOOLS.get(tool, {}).get("cls", ""), 0), tool, time.time()))
            fid = cur.lastrowid
    except Exception:
        return 0
    if proof:
        try:
            d = bh.project_dir(pid) / "poc"
            d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            fn = d / ("%s.proof.txt" % fid)
            fn.write_text(proof[:20000], encoding="utf-8")
            with bh.db() as c:
                c.execute("UPDATE findings SET poc_path=? WHERE id=?", (str(fn), fid))
        except Exception:
            pass
    return 1


def _call(bh, chain, addr, data, frm=DEAD):
    try:
        return True, bh.rpc(chain, "eth_call",
                            [{"from": frm, "to": addr, "data": data, "gas": GAS}, "latest"])
    except Exception as ex:
        return False, str(ex)


def _code(bh, chain, addr):
    try:
        return bh.rpc(chain, "eth_getCode", [addr, "latest"]) or "0x"
    except Exception:
        return "0x"


def _words(hexstr):
    h = (hexstr or "0x")[2:]
    return [h[i:i + 64] for i in range(0, len(h), 64)]


def _sint(w):
    try:
        v = int(w, 16)
    except ValueError:
        return 0
    return v - (1 << 256) if v >= (1 << 255) else v


def _addr(w):
    if not w or len(w) < 40:
        return ""
    a = "0x" + w[-40:]
    return "" if int(a, 16) == 0 else a


def _constants(code):
    """Walk opcodes properly so PUSH payloads are not misread as opcodes."""
    h = code[2:] if code.startswith("0x") else code
    try:
        b = bytes.fromhex(h)
    except ValueError:
        return []
    out, i, n = [], 0, len(b)
    while i < n:
        op = b[i]
        if 0x60 <= op <= 0x7f:
            size = op - 0x5f
            out.append((i, op, b[i + 1:i + 1 + size]))
            i += 1 + size
        else:
            out.append((i, op, b""))
            i += 1
    return out


def _is_contract(bh, chain, addr):
    return len(_code(bh, chain, addr)) > 4


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- chain probes

def probe_privileged(bh, pid, chain, addr, abi, limit=25):
    """Call privileged functions from a random address. No revert means open."""
    n = 0
    tried = 0
    for item in abi:
        if tried >= limit:
            break
        if item.get("type") != "function":
            continue
        if item.get("stateMutability") in ("view", "pure"):
            continue
        name = item.get("name") or ""
        if not PRIV_RE.match(name):
            continue
        ins = item.get("inputs") or []
        if len(ins) > 4:
            continue
        sel = (item.get("name") or "") + "(" + ",".join(
            i.get("type", "") for i in ins) + ")"
        h = _keccak4(bh, sel)
        if not h:
            continue
        data = h + "00" * 32 * len(ins)
        tried += 1
        ok, res = _call(bh, chain, addr, data)
        if ok:
            n += _emit(bh, pid, "m011",
                       "privileged function callable by arbitrary address", "critical",
                       "%s:call:%s" % (addr, name), 0,
                       "eth_call %s from %s succeeded\nselector %s\nreturned %s"
                       % (name, DEAD, h, (res or "0x")[:200]),
                       proof="curl -s $RPC -H 'content-type: application/json' -d "
                             "'{\"jsonrpc\":\"2.0\",\"id\":1,\"method\":\"eth_call\","
                             "\"params\":[{\"from\":\"%s\",\"to\":\"%s\",\"data\":\"%s\"},"
                             "\"latest\"]}'\n" % (DEAD, addr, data))
    return n


def _keccak4(bh, sig):
    """Reuse the 4 byte selector if the ABI gave one, else derive via bh cache."""
    key = "sel:" + sig
    cache = bh.__dict__.setdefault("_SELCACHE", {})
    if key in cache:
        return cache[key]
    h = _sel4_local(sig)
    if h:
        cache[key] = h
    return h


_KECCAK = None


def _sel4_local(sig):
    global _KECCAK
    if _KECCAK is None:
        try:
            import hashlib

            def k(b):
                return hashlib.sha3_256(b).digest()[:4]
            k(b"transfer(address,uint256)")
            _KECCAK = k if k(b"transfer(address,uint256)").hex() == "a9059cbb" else None
        except Exception:
            _KECCAK = None
    if _KECCAK is None:
        return ""
    try:
        return "0x" + _KECCAK(sig.encode()).hex()
    except Exception:
        return ""


def probe_owner(bh, pid, chain, addr):
    n = 0
    ok, own = _call(bh, chain, addr, SEL_OWNER)
    if not ok:
        return 0
    a = _addr((_words(own) or [""])[0])
    if not a:
        return 0
    if not _is_contract(bh, chain, a):
        n += _emit(bh, pid, "m011", "privileged control held by an eoa", "high",
                   "%s:owner" % addr, 0,
                   "owner() = %s which has no code, single key compromise is total" % a,
                   proof="owner() -> %s\neth_getCode(%s) -> 0x\n" % (a, a))
    return n


def probe_proxy(bh, pid, chain, addr):
    n = 0
    impl = admin = beacon = ""
    for slot, tag in ((SLOT_IMPL, "impl"), (SLOT_ADMIN, "admin"), (SLOT_BEACON, "beacon")):
        try:
            v = bh.rpc(chain, "eth_getStorageAt", [addr, slot, "latest"]) or "0x0"
        except Exception:
            v = "0x0"
        a = _addr((_words(v) or [""])[0])
        if tag == "impl":
            impl = a
        elif tag == "admin":
            admin = a
        else:
            beacon = a
    if not impl and not beacon:
        return 0
    n += _emit(bh, pid, "m043", "eip1967 proxy detected", "high", "%s:storage" % addr, 0,
               "impl slot %s, admin slot %s, beacon slot %s"
               % (impl or "-", admin or "-", beacon or "-"))
    if not admin:
        n += _emit(bh, pid, "m041", "proxy admin slot empty", "critical",
                   "%s:storage" % addr, 0,
                   "implementation is set but no admin is recorded at the eip1967 admin slot")
    target = impl or beacon
    if target and _is_contract(bh, chain, target):
        ok, res = _call(bh, chain, target, SEL_INIT + "00" * 32 * 4)
        if ok and (res or "0x") in ("0x", "") or (ok and len(res or "") <= 2):
            n += _emit(bh, pid, "m042", "implementation is initializable", "critical",
                       "%s:impl" % target, 0,
                       "initialize() on implementation %s returns empty from %s, "
                       "an attacker can take ownership of the implementation" % (target, DEAD),
                       proof="eth_call initialize() on %s from %s -> %s\n" % (target, DEAD, res))
        try:
            o2, own2 = _call(bh, chain, target, SEL_OWNER)
            if o2 and not _addr((_words(own2) or [""])[0]):
                n += _emit(bh, pid, "m011", "implementation has no owner", "high",
                           "%s:implowner" % target, 0,
                           "owner() on implementation %s is the zero address" % target)
        except Exception:
            pass
    return n


def probe_oracle(bh, pid, chain, addr, code):
    """Resolve PUSH20 constants, keep the ones that answer latestRoundData."""
    n = 0
    cands = []
    for _, op, data in _constants(code):
        if op != 0x73 or len(data) != 20:
            continue
        a = "0x" + data.hex()
        if a == addr or a in cands:
            continue
        cands.append(a)
        if len(cands) >= 12:
            break
    for a in cands:
        ok, res = _call(bh, chain, a, SEL_LATEST_ROUND)
        w = _words(res) if ok else []
        if len(w) < 5:
            continue
        updated = int(w[3] or "0", 16)
        answer = _sint(w[1])
        round_id = int(w[0] or "0", 16)
        answered = int(w[4] or "0", 16)
        age = int(time.time()) - updated if updated else -1
        if updated and age > 3600:
            n += _emit(bh, pid, "m007", "stale oracle answer accepted", "high",
                       "%s:oracle:%s" % (addr, a), 0,
                       "aggregator %s last updated %d seconds ago\nlatestRoundData -> %s"
                       % (a, age, (res or "")[:200]),
                       proof="latestRoundData(%s) -> updatedAt %d, age %ds\n" % (a, updated, age))
        if answered and round_id and answered < round_id:
            n += _emit(bh, pid, "m008", "oracle round answered out of order", "high",
                       "%s:oracle:%s" % (addr, a), 0,
                       "answeredInRound %d < roundId %d on %s" % (answered, round_id, a))
        if answer <= 0:
            n += _emit(bh, pid, "m009", "non-positive oracle answer", "critical",
                       "%s:oracle:%s" % (addr, a), 0,
                       "answer %d on aggregator %s would corrupt share pricing"
                       % (answer, a))
    return n


def probe_delegatecall(bh, pid, chain, addr, code):
    """PUSH20 immediately preceding a DELEGATECALL is the target."""
    n = 0
    consts = _constants(code)
    seen = set()
    for idx, (off, op, data) in enumerate(consts):
        if op != 0xfa:
            continue
        target = ""
        for j in range(idx - 1, max(-1, idx - 8), -1):
            if consts[j][1] == 0x73 and len(consts[j][2]) == 20:
                target = "0x" + consts[j][2].hex()
                break
        if not target or target in seen or target == addr:
            continue
        seen.add(target)
        if not _is_contract(bh, chain, target):
            n += _emit(bh, pid, "m045", "delegatecall into an address with no code", "critical",
                       "%s:delegatecall" % addr, off,
                       "delegatecall target %s holds no code at this block" % target)
        else:
            n += _emit(bh, pid, "m045", "delegatecall target resolved", "medium",
                       "%s:delegatecall:%s" % (addr, target), off,
                       "delegatecall into %s, verify its storage layout matches" % target)
        if len(seen) >= 6:
            break
    return n


def probe_accounting(bh, pid, chain, addr):
    n = 0
    ok_a, assets = _call(bh, chain, addr, SEL_TOTAL_ASSETS)
    ok_s, supply = _call(bh, chain, addr, SEL_TOTAL_SUPPLY)
    if not ok_a or not ok_s:
        return 0
    total_assets = int((_words(assets) or ["0"])[0] or "0", 16)
    total_supply = int((_words(supply) or ["0"])[0] or "0", 16)
    ok_t, asset = _call(bh, chain, addr, SEL_ASSET)
    underlying = _addr((_words(asset) or [""])[0]) if ok_t else ""
    if not underlying:
        tok0 = _addr((_words((_call(bh, chain, addr, SEL_TOKEN0)[1]) or [""])[0]))
        underlying = tok0
    held = 0
    if underlying:
        ok_b, bal = _call(bh, chain, underlying, SEL_BALANCE_OF + "00" * 12 + addr[2:])
        if ok_b:
            held = int((_words(bal) or ["0"])[0] or "0", 16)
    if total_supply == 0 and (held or total_assets):
        n += _emit(bh, pid, "m019", "first depositor inflation window", "high",
                   "%s:supply" % addr, 0,
                   "totalSupply is 0 while %d assets are already held, share price can be "
                   "inflated before the first mint" % max(held, total_assets),
                   proof="totalSupply() -> 0\nassets held -> %d\n" % max(held, total_assets))
    if held and total_assets > held + held // 500:
        n += _emit(bh, pid, "m020", "totalAssets exceeds held balance", "high",
                   "%s:assets" % addr, 0,
                   "totalAssets() %d vs balanceOf %d, a delta of %d"
                   % (total_assets, held, total_assets - held),
                   proof="totalAssets() -> %d\nbalanceOf(underlying, contract) -> %d\n"
                         % (total_assets, held))
    return n


def probe_callbacks(bh, pid, addr, abi, code):
    n = 0
    names = {i.get("name") for i in abi if i.get("type") == "function"}
    vault = bool(names & {"deposit", "redeem", "withdraw", "mint"})
    if vault and ("tokensReceived" in names or "onERC1155Received" in names):
        n += _emit(bh, pid, "m005", "vault accepts callback tokens", "medium",
                   "%s:hooks" % addr, 0,
                   "deposit path plus token callback hooks present, reentry depends on "
                   "ordering and a guard")
    return n


def contract_checks(bh, pid, addr, chain):
    n = 0
    code = _code(bh, chain, addr)
    if len(code) < 20:
        return 0
    try:
        abi = bh.abi_of(chain, addr) or []
    except Exception:
        abi = []
    n += probe_proxy(bh, pid, chain, addr)
    n += probe_owner(bh, pid, chain, addr)
    n += probe_delegatecall(bh, pid, chain, addr, code)
    n += probe_accounting(bh, pid, chain, addr)
    n += probe_oracle(bh, pid, chain, addr, code)
    if abi:
        n += probe_privileged(bh, pid, chain, addr, abi)
        n += probe_callbacks(bh, pid, addr, abi, code)
    bh.log(pid, "deep: %s %d probe hit(s)" % (addr[:12], n))
    return n

     "access", "m012", r"\binitializer\b"),

     r"(onlyOwner|onlyRole|onlyProxy|_authorizeUpgrade)"),
    (r"getReserves\s*\(|slot0\s*\(", "spot price read directly from the pool", "critical",
     "oracle", "m006", r"(consult|observe|twap|TWAP)"),
    (r"\.swap\s*\(|exactInput|addLiquidity\s*\(", "swap without slippage bound", "high",
     "dex", "m054", r"(amountOutMin|minAmountOut|sqrtPriceLimitX96|minOut)"),
    (r"ecrecover\s*\(", "signature verified without a nonce", "high", "signature", "m038",
     r"\bnonce\b"),
    (r"ecrecover\s*\(", "signature not bound to chain id", "high", "signature", "m040",
     r"(block\.chainid|DOMAIN_SEPARATOR|chainId)"),
    (r"unchecked\s*\{", "arithmetic inside unchecked block", "high", "arithmetic", "m066",
     None),
    (r"uint128\s*\(|uint96\s*\(|uint64\s*\(|uint32\s*\(", "narrowing cast", "medium",
     "precision", "m031", None),
    (r"transferFrom\s*\(", "transferFrom without balance delta check", "high", "token",
     "m060", r"balanceOf\s*\(\s*address\s*\(\s*this\s*\)\s*\)"),
    (r"keccak256\s*\(\s*abi\.encodePacked\s*\([^)]*block\.timestamp",
     "block timestamp as randomness", "high", "crypto", "m079", None),
    (r"selfdestruct\s*\(|suicide\s*\(", "selfdestruct present", "medium", "logic", "m090",
     None),
    (r"tx\.origin\s*==|==\s*tx\.origin", "tx.origin used for authorisation", "medium",
     "access", "m014", None),
    (r"\.call\{[^}]*\}\s*\(\s*\"\"\s*\)", "low level call result ignored", "high", "logic",
     "m087", r"require\s*\(\s*(success|ok|sent)"),

    (r"AccountInfo<'info>", "unvalidated AccountInfo in accounts struct", "critical",

def _rule_pass(bh, pid, path, body, rules, ext):
    n = 0
    lines = body.splitlines()
    for pat, title, sev, cls, tool, must_not in rules:
        m = re.search(pat, body)
        if not m:
            continue
        if must_not and re.search(must_not, body):
            continue
        line = body[:m.start()].count("\n") + 1
        ctx = "\n".join(lines[max(0, line - 3):line + 2])
        n += _emit(bh, pid, tool, title, sev, "%s:%s" % (path, line), line,
                   ctx[:EVID], proof="%s line %d\n%s\n" % (path, line, ctx))
    return n


def _reentrancy(bh, pid, path, body):
    """External call before the state write it should follow."""
    if re.search(r"nonReentrant|ReentrancyGuard", body):
        return 0
    n = 0
    chunks = re.split(r"\n\s{2,}function\s+", body)
    for chunk in chunks:
        head = chunk.split("{", 1)[0]
        call = re.search(r"\.call\{?|safeTransfer\s*\(|\.transfer\s*\(|\.send\s*\(", chunk)
        if not call:
            continue
        write = re.search(r"(\w+\[[^\]]*\]\s*[-+]?=|\b\w+\s*[-+]=\s*|\bdelete\s+\w+)",
                          chunk[call.end():])
        if not write:
            continue
        pos = call.end() + write.start()
        line = body[:pos].count("\n") + 1
        n += _emit(bh, pid, "m001", "state written after external call", "critical",
                   "%s:%s" % (path, line), line,
                   "external call precedes the state update in `%s` with no guard\n%s"
                   % (head.strip()[:80], chunk[max(0, call.start() - 60):pos + 60][:800]),
                   proof="%s:%d\n%s\n" % (path, line, chunk[:1500]))
        break
    return n


def repo_checks(bh, pid, owner, repo, files, fetch_one):
    n = 0
    for path in files:
        try:
            body = fetch_one(owner, repo, path)
        except Exception:
            continue
        if not body:
            continue
        low = path.lower()
        if low.endswith((".sol", ".vy")):
            n += _reentrancy(bh, pid, path, body)
            n += _rule_pass(bh, pid, path, body, SRC_RULES, ".sol")
        elif low.endswith(".rs"):
            n += _rule_pass(bh, pid, path, body, RUST_RULES, ".rs")
    return n


def web_checks(bh, pid, url, body, hdrs):
    n = 0
    root = url.rstrip("/")
    host = bh.urlparse(url).netloc if hasattr(bh, "urlparse") else ""
    # open redirect
    for param in ("next", "redirect", "url", "return", "returnUrl", "continue", "dest"):
        for sep in ("?", "&"):
            probe = "%s%s%s=//evil.example" % (root, sep, param)
            code, b2, h2, _ = bh.fetch_full(probe)
            loc = (h2.get("location") or "")
            if "evil.example" in loc or "evil.example" in (b2 or "")[:400]:
                n += _emit(bh, pid, "m100", "open redirect", "medium",
                           "%s:%s" % (url, param), 0,
                           "GET %s -> %d, location %s" % (probe, code, loc[:200]),
                           proof="GET %s\n-> %d %s\n" % (probe, code, loc))
                break
    # traversal
    for probe in ("/..%2f..%2fetc%2fpasswd", "/static/../.env", "/.%2e/.env"):
        code, b2, _, _ = bh.fetch_full(root + probe)
        if code == 200 and ("root:" in b2 or re.search(r"^[A-Z_]+=", b2, re.M)):
            n += _emit(bh, pid, "m100", "path traversal", "high", root + probe, 0,
                       b2[:300], proof="GET %s\n-> 200\n%s\n" % (root + probe, b2[:500]))
            break
    # host header injection
    code, b2, h2, _ = bh.fetch_full(url, headers={"X-Forwarded-Host": "evil.example"})
    if "evil.example" in (b2 or "")[:2000] or "evil.example" in (h2.get("location") or ""):
        n += _emit(bh, pid, "m105", "host header reflected", "medium", url, 0,
                   "X-Forwarded-Host echoed into the response")
    # graphql
    code, b2, _, _ = bh.fetch_full(root + "/graphql", data=b'{"query":"{__typename}"}',
                                   headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
                                   method="POST")
    if code == 200 and "__typename" in (b2 or ""):
        n += _emit(bh, pid, "m110", "graphql endpoint answering", "medium",
                   root + "/graphql", 0, (b2 or "")[:300],
                   proof="POST %s/graphql {__typename} -> %s\n" % (root, (b2 or "")[:300]))
        code2, b2b, _, _ = bh.fetch_full(
            root + "/graphql", data=b'{"query":"{__schema{types{name}}}"}',
            headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"}, method="POST")
        if code2 == 200 and "__schema" in (b2b or ""):
            n += _emit(bh, pid, "m110", "graphql introspection enabled", "high",
                       root + "/graphql", 0, "schema dump served to anonymous caller")
    # jwt alg none
    tok = "eyJhbGciOiJub25lIiwidHlwIjoiSldUIn0.eyJzdWIiOiJhZG1pbiIsInJvbGUiOiJhZG1pbiJ9."
    for path in ("/api/me", "/api/user", "/api/v1/me", "/me"):
        code, b2, _, _ = bh.fetch_full(root + path,
                                       headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + tok})
        if code == 200 and len(b2 or "") > 2 and "error" not in (b2 or "").lower()[:60]:
            n += _emit(bh, pid, "m101", "unsigned jwt accepted", "critical", root + path, 0,
                       "alg=none token accepted at %s -> %s" % (path, (b2 or "")[:200]),
                       proof="GET %s with alg none token -> 200\n%s\n"
                             % (root + path, (b2 or "")[:300]))
            break
    # debug surface
    for path in ("/debug/pprof/", "/metrics", "/actuator", "/api-docs", "/.git/HEAD",
                 "/console", "/telescope"):
        code, b2, _, _ = bh.fetch_full(root + path)
        if code == 200 and len(b2 or "") > 30:
            n += _emit(bh, pid, "m104", "debug surface exposed", "medium", root + path, 0,
                       b2[:200])
    return n


def run(bh, pid, targets=None):
    p = bh.getp(pid)
    if not p:
        return 0
    if not bh._envb("BH_DEEP", True):
        return 0
    limit = bh._envi("BH_DEEP_MAX", 6)
    targets = targets or bh.collect_targets(pid)
    n = 0
    done = 0
    for t in targets:
        if done >= limit or bh.STOP.is_set():
            break
        if bh.ADDR_RE.fullmatch(t):
            chain = bh.chain_of(t)
            if not chain:
                continue
            done += 1
            try:
                n += contract_checks(bh, pid, t, chain)
            except Exception as ex:
                bh.log(pid, "deep: %s %s" % (t[:12], ex))
        elif "github.com" in t:
            m = re.search(r"github\.com/([\w.-]+)/([\w.-]+)", t)
            if not m:
                continue
            done += 1
            try:
                meta, owner, repo = bh._resolve_repo(pid, m.group(1), m.group(2).rstrip("."))
                if not meta:
                    continue
                tree = json.loads(bh.gh("/repos/%s/%s/git/trees/HEAD?recursive=1"
                                        % (owner, repo)))
                want = (".sol", ".rs")
                files = [x["path"] for x in tree.get("tree") or []
                         if x.get("type") == "blob" and x["path"].lower().endswith(want)]
                files.sort(key=lambda q: (0 if "/src/" in "/" + q else 1, len(q)))
                files = files[:bh._envi("BH_DEEP_FILES", 6)]
                if not files:
                    continue

                def fetch_one(o, r, path):
                    return bh.fetch("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/%s/%s/HEAD/%s"
                                    % (o, r, path), timeout=30)[:200000]
                n += repo_checks(bh, pid, owner, repo, files, fetch_one)
            except Exception as ex:
                bh.log(pid, "deep: repo %s" % ex)
        else:
            continue
    if p["url"].startswith("http"):
        try:
            code, body, hdrs, _ = bh.fetch_full(p["url"])
            if code and code < 400:
                n += web_checks(bh, pid, p["url"], body, hdrs)
        except Exception as ex:
            bh.log(pid, "deep: web %s" % ex)
    bh.log(pid, "deep: %d hit(s) total" % n)
    return n
