def plan(pid):
    p = getp(pid)
    if not p:
        return {"levels": []}
    tc = p["toolchain"]
    pol = load_conditions(pid)
    levels = []
    for lvl in range(6):
        sel = [k for k, v in TOOLS.items()
               if v["lvl"] == lvl and (not v["langs"] or tc in v["langs"] or tc == "unknown")]
        if FUND_ONLY[0]:
            sel = [k for k in sel if TOOLS[k]["fund"]]
        if lvl == 5:
            sel = sel[:HAMMER_DEPTH]
        levels.append({"level": lvl,
                       "name": ["recon", "static", "symbolic", "dynamic", "adversarial",
                                "hammer"][lvl],
                       "count": len(sel), "tools": sel, "applicable": lvl == 0 or bool(sel),
                       "note": "" if sel else "no applicable methods"})
    return {"levels": levels, "label": tc, "scope_model": pol.get("scope_model", "unknown"),
            "poc_required": bool((pol.get("poc") or {}).get("required")),
            "threshold": THRESHOLD, "details_ok": bool(p["details_ok"]),
            "web_target": "web" in (tc or "")}


def state():
    with db() as c:
        rows = c.execute("SELECT * FROM projects ORDER BY rank DESC, id DESC").fetchall()
        hits = {r["pid"]: r["n"] for r in
                c.execute("SELECT pid, COUNT(*) n FROM findings GROUP BY pid").fetchall()}
        unj = {r["pid"]: r["n"] for r in c.execute(
            "SELECT pid, COUNT(*) n FROM findings WHERE judged=0 GROUP BY pid").fetchall()}
        rdy = {r["pid"]: r["n"] for r in c.execute(
            "SELECT pid, COUNT(*) n FROM findings WHERE eligible=1 GROUP BY pid").fetchall()}
        reps = {r["pid"]: r["n"] for r in c.execute(
            "SELECT pid, COUNT(*) n FROM repairs GROUP BY pid").fetchall()}
        tally = {s: 0 for s in SEV_ORDER}
        for r in c.execute("SELECT sev, COUNT(*) n FROM findings GROUP BY sev").fetchall():
            tally[r["sev"]] = r["n"]
    live = running_pids()
    projects = []
    for r in rows:
        d = dict(r)
        d["hits"] = hits.get(r["id"], 0)
        d["unjudged"] = unj.get(r["id"], 0)
        d["ready"] = rdy.get(r["id"], 0)
        d["repairs"] = reps.get(r["id"], 0)
        d["live"] = r["id"] in live
        d["web"] = r["toolchain"] == "web"
        projects.append(d)
    return {"projects": projects, "tally": tally, "running": len(live), "workers": WORKERS,
            "tools": len(TOOLS), "threshold": THRESHOLD, "fund_only": FUND_ONLY[0],
            "stopped": STOP.is_set(), "auto_discover": AUTO_DISCOVER,
            "fund": sum(d["fund_hits"] for d in projects), "repair_kinds": REPAIR_KINDS,
            "net_seconds": round(NET_TIME[0], 1)}


class Bad(Exception):
    def __init__(self, msg, errors=None):
        super().__init__(msg)
        self.errors = errors or [msg]


GET = {}
POST = {}


def get(path):
    def deco(fn):
        GET[path] = fn
        return fn
    return deco


def post(path):
    def deco(fn):
        POST[path] = fn
        return fn
    return deco

            "net_seconds": round(NET_TIME[0], 1),

class H(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    protocol_version = "HTTP/1.1"
    server_version = "bountyhunter/10"

    def log_message(self, *a):
        pass

    def _j(self, obj, code=200):
        b = json.dumps(obj, default=str).encode()
        self.send_response(code)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(b)))
        self.send_header("Cache-Control", "no-store")
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(b)
        self.close_connection = True

    def _h(self, body, ctype="text/html; charset=utf-8"):
        b = body.encode() if isinstance(body, str) else body
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", ctype)
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(b)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(b)
        self.close_connection = True

    def _body(self):
        n = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length") or 0)
        if not n:
            return {}
        try:
            return json.loads(self.rfile.read(n) or b"{}")
        except Exception:
            return {}

    def do_GET(self):
        self.route("GET")

    def do_POST(self):
        self.route("POST")

    def route(self, m):
        u = urlparse(self.path)
        q = {k: v[0] for k, v in parse_qs(u.query).items()}
        try:
            if u.path in ("/", "/index.html"):
                return self._h(UI.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            if m == "GET":
                fn = GET.get(u.path)
                if fn:
                    return self._j(fn(q))
                return self._j({"msg": "not found"}, 404)
            fn = POST.get(u.path)
            if not fn:
                return self._j({"msg": "not found"}, 404)
            try:
                return self._j(fn(self._body()))
            except Bad as ex:
                return self._j({"msg": str(ex), "errors": ex.errors}, 400)
        except Exception as ex:
            traceback.print_exc()
            return self._j({"msg": "%s: %s" % (type(ex).__name__, ex)}, 500)


def serve():
    for port in PORTS:
        try:
            ThreadingHTTPServer.allow_reuse_address = True
            srv = ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", port), H)
        except OSError:
            continue
        srv.daemon_threads = True
        log(0, "ui: http://127.0.0.1:%d" % port)
        for fn in (log_writer, heartbeat, discover_loop, autopilot):
            threading.Thread(target=fn, daemon=True).start()
        for _ in range(WORKERS):
            threading.Thread(target=worker, daemon=True).start()
        threading.Thread(target=lambda u: webbrowser.open(u),
                         args=("http://127.0.0.1:%d" % port,), daemon=True).start()
        srv.serve_forever()
        return
    log(0, "no free port")


def main():
    init()
    STOP.clear()
    with db() as c:
        n = c.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM projects").fetchone()["n"]
        revived = c.execute("UPDATE projects SET status='new', dry=0, cycle=0, attempts=0 "
                            "WHERE status='exhausted'").rowcount
    log(0, "BountyHunter 10 - %d methods, %d fund, %d projects, %d manual"
        % (len(TOOLS), len(FUND), n, len(manual_rows())))
    log(0, "chain: %d rpc, etherscan %s, eth $%.0f, census %s"
        % (len([v for v in RPC.values() if v]), "set" if ETHERSCAN else "off", ETH_USD,
           "on" if VALUE_CENSUS else "off"))
    log(0, "gates: threshold %d, attempts %d, repairs %d, dry cap %d, hammer %d"
        % (THRESHOLD, MAX_ATTEMPTS, MAX_REPAIRS, MAX_CYCLES, HAMMER_DEPTH))
    log(0, "scan: %d target(s), %d file(s), %d path(s), %d bytes, poc cap %d"
        % (SCAN_TARGETS, SCAN_FILES, SCAN_PATHS, SCAN_BYTES, POC_MAX))
    log(0, "deep: %s, %d target(s) per pass, %d source file(s) per repo"
        % ("on" if _envb("BH_DEEP", True) else "off", _envi("BH_DEEP_MAX", 6),
           _envi("BH_DEEP_FILES", 6)))
    if revived:
        log(0, "revive: %d exhausted row(s) re-armed" % revived)
    if DUPES:
        log(0, "env conflicts: %s" % ", ".join(sorted(set(DUPES))))
    serve()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""deep.py - invariant probes and proof checks.

Called by bh.py as deep.run(bh, pid). Every check either calls the chain,
reads verified source, or reads a fetched page, and every hit is stored with
the exact call or line that produced it plus a proof artifact under poc/.

Rules of the house:
  * never assume an ABI exists, always degrade quietly
  * one dead node must not abort the remaining checks
  * prefer a provable call over a grep, and a grep over a guess
"""
import json
import re
import sys
import time

DEAD = "0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD"
GAS = "0x2dc6c0"

SEL_LATEST_ROUND = "0xfeaf968c"
SEL_OWNER = "0x8da5cb5b"
SEL_INIT = "0x8129fc1c"
SEL_TOTAL_ASSETS = "0x01e1d114"
SEL_TOTAL_SUPPLY = "0x18160ddd"
SEL_ASSET = "0x38d52e0f"
SEL_BALANCE_OF = "0x70a08231"
SEL_TOKEN0 = "0x0dfe1681"

SLOT_IMPL = "0x360894a13ba1a3210667c828492db98dca3e2076cc3735a920a3ca505d382bbc"
SLOT_ADMIN = "0xb53127684a568b3173ae13b9f8a6016e243e63b6e8ee1178d6a717850b5d6103"
SLOT_BEACON = "0xa3f0ad74e5423aebfd80d3ef4346578335a9a72aeaee59ff6cb3582b35133d50"

PRIV_RE = re.compile(
    r"^(set|update|upgrade|initialize|init|mint|burn|pause|unpause|withdraw|sweep|"
    r"rescue|emergency|execute|claim|add|remove|grant|revoke|transferOwnership|"
    r"change|toggle|enable|disable|kill|migrate|rebalance|harvest)", re.I)

EVID = 4000


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ plumbing

def _emit(bh, pid, tool, title, sev, file, line, evidence, proof=None):
    t = bh.TOOLS.get(tool, {})
    try:
        with bh.db() as c:
            if c.execute("SELECT id FROM findings WHERE pid=? AND title=? AND file=?",
                         (pid, title[:300], file[:300])).fetchone():
                return 0
            cur = c.execute(
                "INSERT INTO findings(pid,title,sev,cls,file,line,evidence,score,fund,reward,"
                "tool,ts) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,<｜begin▁of▁sentence｜>#?,?,?,?,?)".replace("#", "?"),
                (pid, title[:300], sev, t.get("cls", "logic"), file[:300], line,
                 evidence[:20000],
                 min(100, bh.SEV_W.get(sev, 14) + t.get("reward", 0) // 400
                     + min(12, len(evidence) // 120) + 8),
                 1 if t.get("fund") else 0,
                 bh.REWARD.get(t.get("cls", ""), 0), tool, time.time()))
            fid = cur.lastrowid
    except Exception:
        return 0
    if proof:
        try:
            d = bh.project_dir(pid) / "poc"
            d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            fn = d / ("%s.proof.txt" % fid)
            fn.write_text(proof[:20000], encoding="utf-8")
            with bh.db() as c:
                c.execute("UPDATE findings SET poc_path=? WHERE id=?", (str(fn), fid))
        except Exception:
            pass
    return 1


def _sel4(sig):
    """4 byte selector from whatever keccak the install happens to have."""
    for name in ("sel4", "selector", "keccak4", "sig4"):
        try:
            mod = sys.modules.get("contract")
            f = getattr(mod, name) if mod else None
            if not f:
                continue
            v = f(sig)
            if isinstance(v, str) and len(v) in (8, 10):
                return v if v.startswith("0x") else "0x" + v
        except Exception:
            continue
    try:
        from Crypto.Hash import keccak
        k = keccak.new(digest_bits=256)
        k.update(sig.encode())
        return "0x" + k.hexdigest()[:8]
    except Exception:
        pass
    try:
        from eth_hash.auto import keccak as kk
        return "0x" + kk(sig.encode()).hex()[:8]
    except Exception:
        pass
    return ""


def _call(bh, chain, addr, data, frm=DEAD):
    try:
        return True, bh.rpc(chain, "eth_call",
                            [{"from": frm, "to": addr, "data": data, "gas": GAS}, "latest"])
    except Exception as ex:
        return False, str(ex)


def _code(bh, chain, addr):
    try:
        return bh.rpc(chain, "eth_getCode", [addr, "latest"]) or "0x"
    except Exception:
        return "0x"


def _words(h):
    h = (h or "0x")[2:]
    return [h[i:i + 64] for i in range(0, len(h), 64)]


def _sint(w):
    try:
        v = int(w, 16)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return 0
    return v - (1 << 256) if v >= (1 << 255) else v


def _addr(w):
    if not w or len(w) < 40:
        return ""
    a = "0x" + w[-40:]
    return "" if int(a, 16) == 0 else a


def _constants(code):
    """Walk opcodes so PUSH payloads are not misread as opcodes."""
    h = code[2:] if code.startswith("0x") else code
    try:
        b = bytes.fromhex(h)
    except ValueError:
        return []
    out, i, n = [], 0, len(b)
    while i < n:
        op = b[i]
        if 0x60 <= op <= 0x7f:
            size = op - 0x5f
            out.append((i, op, b[i + 1:i + 1 + size]))
            i += 1 + size
        else:
            out.append((i, op, b""))
            i += 1
    return out


def _is_contract(bh, chain, addr):
    return len(_code(bh, chain, addr)) > 4


# -------------------------------------------------------------- chain probes

def probe_privileged(bh, pid, chain, addr, abi, limit=25):
    """Call privileged functions from a throwaway address. No revert means open."""
    n = tried = 0
    for item in abi:
        if tried >= limit:
            break
        if item.get("type") != "function":
            continue
        if item.get("stateMutability") in ("view", "pure"):
            continue
        name = item.get("name") or ""
        if not PRIV_RE.match(name):
            continue
        ins = item.get("inputs") or []
        if len(ins) > 4:
            continue
        sig = "%s(%s)" % (name, ",".join(i.get("type", "") for i in ins))
        h = _sel4(sig)
        if not h:
            continue
        data = h + "00" * 32 * len(ins)
        tried += 1
        ok, res = _call(bh, chain, addr, data)
        if not ok:
            continue
        n += _emit(bh, pid, "m011", "privileged function callable by arbitrary address",
                   "critical", "%s:call:%s" % (addr, name), 0,
                   "eth_call %s from %s returned without revert\nselector %s\nresult %s"
                   % (sig, DEAD, h, (res or "0x")[:200]),
                   proof="curl -s \"$ETH_RPC_URL\" -H 'content-type: application/json' -d "
                         "'{\"jsonrpc\":\"2.0\",\"id\":1,\"method\":\"eth_call\","
                         "\"params\":[{\"from\":\"%s\",\"to\":\"%s\",\"data\":\"%s\"},"
                         "\"latest\"]}'\n" % (DEAD, addr, data))
    return n


def probe_owner(bh, pid, chain, addr):
    ok, own = _call(bh, chain, addr, SEL_OWNER)
    if not ok:
        return 0
    a = _addr((_words(own) or [""])[0])
    if not a or _is_contract(bh, chain, a):
        return 0
    return _emit(bh, pid, "m011", "privileged control held by an eoa", "high",
                 "%s:owner" % addr, 0,
                 "owner() = %s, no code there, one key compromise is total loss" % a,
                 proof="owner() -> %s\neth_getCode(%s) -> 0x\n" % (a, a))


def probe_proxy(bh, pid, chain, addr):
    n = 0
    got = {}
    for slot, tag in ((SLOT_IMPL, "impl"), (SLOT_ADMIN, "admin"), (SLOT_BEACON, "beacon")):
        try:
            v = bh.rpc(chain, "eth_getStorageAt", [addr, slot, "latest"]) or "0x0"
        except Exception:
            v = "0x0"
        got[tag] = _addr((_words(v) or [""])[0])
    impl, admin, beacon = got["impl"], got["admin"], got["beacon"]
    if not impl and not beacon:
        return 0
    n += _emit(bh, pid, "m043", "eip1967 proxy detected", "high", "%s:storage" % addr, 0,
               "impl %s, admin %s, beacon %s" % (impl or "-", admin or "-", beacon or "-"))
    if not admin:
        n += _emit(bh, pid, "m041", "proxy admin slot empty", "critical",
                   "%s:storage" % addr, 0,
                   "implementation set but the eip1967 admin slot is zero")
    target = impl or beacon
    if target and _is_contract(bh, chain, target):
        ok, res = _call(bh, chain, target, SEL_INIT + "00" * 32 * 4)
        if ok and (res or "0x") in ("0x", "0x0", ""):
            n += _emit(bh, pid, "m042", "implementation is initializable", "critical",
                       "%s:impl" % target, 0,
                       "initialize() on implementation %s returns empty from %s, ownership of "
                       "the implementation is takeable" % (target, DEAD),
                       proof="eth_call initialize() on %s from %s -> %s\n"
                             % (target, DEAD, res))
        ok2, own2 = _call(bh, chain, target, SEL_OWNER)
        if ok2 and not _addr((_words(own2) or [""])[0]):
            n += _emit(bh, pid, "m011", "implementation has no owner", "high",
                       "%s:implowner" % target, 0,
                       "owner() on implementation %s is the zero address" % target)
    return n


def probe_delegatecall(bh, pid, chain, addr, code):
    n = 0
    consts = _constants(code)
    seen = set()
    for idx, (off, op, data) in enumerate(consts):
        if op != 0xfa:
            continue
        target = ""
        for j in range(idx - 1, max(-1, idx - 8), -1):
            if consts[j][1] == 0x73 and len(consts[j][2]) == 20:
                target = "0x" + consts[j][2].hex()
                break
        if not target or target in seen or target == addr:
            continue
        seen.add(target)
        if not _is_contract(bh, chain, target):
            n += _emit(bh, pid, "m045", "delegatecall into an address with no code",
                       "critical", "%s:delegatecall" % addr, off,
                       "delegatecall target %s holds no code at this block" % target)
        else:
            n += _emit(bh, pid, "m045", "delegatecall target resolved", "medium",
                       "%s:delegatecall:%s" % (addr, target), off,
                       "delegatecall into %s, check its storage layout against the caller"
                       % target)
        if len(seen) >= 6:
            break
    return n


def probe_accounting(bh, pid, chain, addr):
    ok_a, assets = _call(bh, chain, addr, SEL_TOTAL_ASSETS)
    ok_s, supply = _call(bh, chain, addr, SEL_TOTAL_SUPPLY)
    if not ok_a or not ok_s:
        return 0
    n = 0
    total_assets = int((_words(assets) or ["0"])[0] or "0", 16)
    total_supply = int((_words(supply) or ["0"])[0] or "0", 16)
    ok_t, asset = _call(bh, chain, addr, SEL_ASSET)
    underlying = _addr((_words(asset) or [""])[0]) if ok_t else ""
    if not underlying:
        underlying = _addr((_words(_call(bh, chain, addr, SEL_TOKEN0)[1]) or [""])[0])
    held = 0
    if underlying:
        ok_b, bal = _call(bh, chain, underlying, SEL_BALANCE_OF + "00" * 12 + addr[2:])
        if ok_b:
            held = int((_words(bal) or ["0"])[0] or "0", 16)
    if total_supply == 0 and (held or total_assets):
        n += _emit(bh, pid, "m019", "first depositor inflation window", "high",
                   "%s:supply" % addr, 0,
                   "totalSupply is 0 while %d asset units are already held, share price can "
                   "be inflated before the first mint" % max(held, total_assets),
                   proof="totalSupply() -> 0\nheld -> %d\n" % max(held, total_assets))
    if held and total_assets > held + held // 500:
        n += _emit(bh, pid, "m020", "totalAssets exceeds held balance", "high",
                   "%s:assets" % addr, 0,
                   "totalAssets() %d against balanceOf %d, delta %d"
                   % (total_assets, held, total_assets - held),
                   proof="totalAssets() -> %d\nbalanceOf(underlying) -> %d\n"
                         % (total_assets, held))
    return n


def probe_oracle(bh, pid, chain, addr, code):
    n = 0
    cands = []
    for _, op, data in _constants(code):
        if op != 0x73 or len(data) != 20:
            continue
        a = "0x" + data.hex()
        if a == addr or a in cands:
            continue
        cands.append(a)
        if len(cands) >= 12:
            break
    for a in cands:
        ok, res = _call(bh, chain, a, SEL_LATEST_ROUND)
        w = _words(res) if ok else []
        if len(w) < 5:
            continue
        round_id = int(w[0] or "0", 16)
        answer = _sint(w[1])
        updated = int(w[3] or "0", 16)
        answered = int(w[4] or "0", 16)
        age = int(time.time()) - updated if updated else -1
        if updated and age > 3600:
            n += _emit(bh, pid, "m007", "stale oracle answer accepted", "high",
                       "%s:oracle:%s" % (addr, a), 0,
                       "aggregator %s last updated %d seconds ago\nlatestRoundData %s"
                       % (a, age, (res or "")[:200]),
                       proof="latestRoundData(%s) -> updatedAt %d, age %ds\n"
                             % (a, updated, age))
        if answered and round_id and answered < round_id:
            n += _emit(bh, pid, "m008", "oracle round answered out of order", "high",
                       "%s:oracle:%s" % (addr, a), 0,
                       "answeredInRound %d below roundId %d on %s"
                       % (answered, round_id, a))
        if answer <= 0:
            n += _emit(bh, pid, "m009", "non-positive oracle answer", "critical",
                       "%s:oracle:%s" % (addr, a), 0,
                       "answer %d on %s corrupts any price derived from it" % (answer, a))
    return n


def probe_callbacks(bh, pid, addr, abi):
    names = {i.get("name") for i in abi if i.get("type") == "function"}
    if not names & {"deposit", "redeem", "withdraw", "mint"}:
        return 0
    if not names & {"tokensReceived", "onERC1155Received", "onERC721Received"}:
        return 0
    return _emit(bh, pid, "m005", "vault accepts callback tokens", "medium",
                 "%s:hooks" % addr, 0,
                 "deposit path plus token callbacks, safety rests entirely on call ordering")


def contract_checks(bh, pid, addr, chain):
    code = _code(bh, chain, addr)
    if len(code) < 20:
        return 0
    try:
        abi = bh.abi_of(chain, addr) or []
    except Exception:
        abi = []
    n = 0
    for fn in (probe_proxy, probe_owner):
        try:
            n += fn(bh, pid, chain, addr)
        except Exception as ex:
            bh.log(pid, "deep: %s" % ex)
    try:
        n += probe_delegatecall(bh, pid, chain, addr, code)
    except Exception as ex:
        bh.log(pid, "deep: %s" % ex)
    try:
        n += probe_accounting(bh, pid, chain, addr)
    except Exception as ex:
        bh.log(pid, "deep: %s" % ex)
    try:
        n += probe_oracle(bh, pid, chain, addr, code)
    except Exception as ex:
        bh.log(pid, "deep: %s" % ex)
    if abi:
        try:
            n += probe_privileged(bh, pid, chain, addr, abi)
        except Exception as ex:
            bh.log(pid, "deep: %s" % ex)
        try:
            n += probe_callbacks(bh, pid, addr, abi)
        except Exception as ex:
            bh.log(pid, "deep: %s" % ex)
    bh.log(pid, "deep: %s %d hit(s)" % (addr[:12], n))
    return n


# -------------------------------------------------------------- source rules

SRC_RULES = [
    (r"delegatecall\s*\(", "delegatecall result not checked", "critical", "upgrade", "m045",
     r"require\s*\(\s*(success|ok|\(bool|delegateSuccess)"),
    (r"function\s+initialize\s*\(", "initializer without initializer modifier", "critical",
     "access", "m012", r"\binitializer\b"),
    (r"function\s+(upgradeTo|upgradeToAndCall|_authorizeUpgrade)\s*\(",
     "upgrade path without authorisation", "critical", "upgrade", "m041",
     r"(onlyOwner|onlyRole|onlyProxy|_authorizeUpgrade)"),
    (r"getReserves\s*\(|slot0\s*\(", "spot price read straight from the pool", "critical",
     "oracle", "m006", r"(consult|observe|twap|TWAP)"),
    (r"\.swap\s*\(|exactInput|addLiquidity\s*\(", "swap without a slippage bound", "high",
     "dex", "m054", r"(amountOutMin|minAmountOut|sqrtPriceLimitX96|minOut)"),
    (r"ecrecover\s*\(", "signature verified without a nonce", "high", "signature", "m038",
     r"\bnonce\b"),
    (r"ecrecover\s*\(", "signature not bound to chain id", "high", "signature", "m040",
     r"(block\.chainid|DOMAIN_SEPARATOR|chainId)"),
    (r"unchecked\s*\{", "arithmetic inside an unchecked block", "high", "arithmetic", "m066",
     None),
    (r"uint128\s*\(|uint96\s*\(|uint64\s*\(|uint32\s*\(", "narrowing cast", "medium",
     "precision", "m031", None),
    (r"transferFrom\s*\(", "transferFrom without a balance delta check", "high", "token",
     "m060", r"balanceOf\s*\(\s*address\s*\(\s*this\s*\)\s*\)"),
    (r"keccak256\s*\(\s*abi\.encodePacked\s*\([^)]*block\.timestamp",
     "block timestamp used as randomness", "high", "crypto", "m079", None),
    (r"selfdestruct\s*\(|suicide\s*\(", "selfdestruct present", "medium", "logic", "m090",
     None),
    (r"tx\.origin\s*==|==\s*tx\.origin", "tx.origin used for authorisation", "medium",
     "access", "m014", None),
    (r"\.call\{[^}]*\}\s*\(\s*\"\"\s*\)", "low level call result ignored", "high", "logic",
     "m087", r"require\s*\(\s*(success|ok|sent)"),
    (r"function\s+(liquidate|seize)\s*\(", "liquidation path, health not recomputed",
     "medium", "liquidation", "m022", r"(healthFactor|isLiquidatable|_getHealth)"),
]

RUST_RULES = [
    (r"AccountInfo<'info>", "unvalidated AccountInfo in an accounts struct", "critical",
     "deserial", "m077", r"#\[account\("),
    (r"invoke\s*\(", "cpi without a program id comparison", "critical", "cpi", "m068",
     r"program_id\s*==|key\(\)\s*==\s*&"),
    (r"\bas\s+u64\b|\bas\s+u128\b", "lossy integer cast", "medium", "precision", "m031",
     None),
    (r"\.unwrap\(\)", "unwrap in a handler path", "medium", "logic", "m086", None),
    (r"authority\s*:", "authority field without a signer constraint", "critical", "auth",
     "m078", r"signer"),
]


def _rule_pass(bh, pid, path, body, rules):
    n = 0
    lines = body.splitlines()
    for pat, title, sev, cls, tool, must_not in rules:
        m = re.search(pat, body)
        if not m:
            continue
        if must_not and re.search(must_not, body):
            continue
        line = body[:m.start()].count("\n") + 1
        ctx = "\n".join(lines[max(0, line - 3):line + 2])
        n += _emit(bh, pid, tool, title, sev, "%s:%s" % (path, line), line, ctx[:EVID],
                   proof="%s line %d\n%s\n" % (path, line, ctx))
    return n


def _reentrancy(bh, pid, path, body):
    """External call placed before the state write that should precede it."""
    if re.search(r"nonReentrant|ReentrancyGuard", body):
        return 0
    for chunk in re.split(r"\n\s{2,}function\s+", body):
        head = chunk.split("{", 1)[0]
        call = re.search(r"\.call\{?|safeTransfer\s*\(|\.transfer\s*\(|\.send\s*\(", chunk)
        if not call:
            continue
        write = re.search(r"(\w+\[[^\]]*\]\s*[-+]?=|\b\w+\s*[-+]=\s*|\bdelete\s+\w+)",
                          chunk[call.end():])
        if not write:
            continue
        pos = call.end() + write.start()
        line = body[:pos].count("\n") + 1
        return _emit(bh, pid, "m001", "state written after an external call", "critical",
                     "%s:%s" % (path, line), line,
                     "external call precedes the state update in `%s`, no guard in file\n%s"
                     % (head.strip()[:80], chunk[max(0, call.start() - 60):pos + 60][:800]),
                     proof="%s:%d\n%s\n" % (path, line, chunk[:1500]))
    return 0


def repo_checks(bh, pid, owner, repo, files):
    n = 0
    for path in files:
        try:
            body = bh.fetch("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/%s/%s/HEAD/%s"
                            % (owner, repo, path), timeout=30)[:200000]
        except Exception:
            continue
        low = path.lower()
        if low.endswith((".sol", ".vy")):
            n += _reentrancy(bh, pid, path, body)
            n += _rule_pass(bh, pid, path, body, SRC_RULES)
        elif low.endswith(".rs"):
            n += _rule_pass(bh, pid, path, body, RUST_RULES)
    return n


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ web probes

def web_checks(bh, pid, url):
    n = 0
    root = url.rstrip("/")
    code, body, hdrs, _ = bh.fetch_full(root)
    if not code or code >= 400:
        return 0
    for param in ("next", "redirect", "url", "return", "returnUrl", "continue", "dest"):
        for sep in ("?", "&"):
            probe = "%s%s%s=//evil.example" % (root, sep, param)
            c2, b2, h2, _ = bh.fetch_full(probe)
            loc = h2.get("location") or ""
            if "evil.example" in loc or "evil.example" in (b2 or "")[:400]:
                n += _emit(bh, pid, "m100", "open redirect", "medium", "%s:%s" % (url, param),
                           0, "GET %s -> %d, location %s" % (probe, c2, loc[:200]),
                           proof="GET %s\n-> %d %s\n" % (probe, c2, loc))
                break
    for probe in ("/..%2f..%2fetc%2fpasswd", "/static/../.env", "/.%2e/.env"):
        c2, b2, _, _ = bh.fetch_full(root + probe)
        if c2 == 200 and ("root:" in b2 or re.search(r"^[A-Z_]{3,}=", b2, re.M)):
            n += _emit(bh, pid, "m100", "path traversal", "high", root + probe, 0,
                       b2[:300], proof="GET %s\n-> 200\n%s\n" % (root + probe, b2[:500]))
            break
    c2, b2, h2, _ = bh.fetch_full(url, headers={"X-Forwarded-Host": "evil.example"})
    if "evil.example" in (b2 or "")[:2000] or "evil.example" in (h2.get("location") or ""):
        n += _emit(bh, pid, "m105", "host header reflected", "medium", url, 0,
                   "X-Forwarded-Host echoed into the response body or location")
    c2, b2, _, _ = bh.fetch_full(root + "/graphql", data=b'{"query":"{__typename}"}',
                                 headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
                                 method="POST")
    if c2 == 200 and "__typename" in (b2 or ""):
        n += _emit(bh, pid, "m110", "graphql endpoint answering", "medium",
                   root + "/graphql", 0, (b2 or "")[:300],
                   proof="POST %s/graphql {__typename} -> %s\n" % (root, (b2 or "")[:300]))
        c3, b3, _, _ = bh.fetch_full(root + "/graphql",
                                     data=b'{"query":"{__schema{types{name}}}"}',
                                     headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
                                     method="POST")
        if c3 == 200 and "__schema" in (b3 or ""):
            n += _emit(bh, pid, "m110", "graphql introspection enabled", "high",
                       root + "/graphql", 0, "full schema served to an anonymous caller")
    tok = ("eyJhbGciOiJub25lIiwidHlwIjoiSldUIn0."
           "eyJzdWIiOiJhZG1pbiIsInJvbGUiOiJhZG1pbiJ9.")
    for path in ("/api/me", "/api/user", "/api/v1/me", "/me", "/api/v1/user"):
        c2, b2, _, _ = bh.fetch_full(root + path,
                                     headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + tok})
        if c2 == 200 and len(b2 or "") > 2 and "error" not in (b2 or "").lower()[:60]:
            n += _emit(bh, pid, "m101", "unsigned jwt accepted", "critical", root + path, 0,
                       "alg=none token accepted at %s -> %s" % (path, (b2 or "")[:200]),
                       proof="GET %s with alg none token -> 200\n%s\n"
                             % (root + path, (b2 or "")[:300]))
            break
    for path in ("/debug/pprof/", "/metrics", "/actuator", "/api-docs", "/.git/HEAD",
                 "/console", "/telescope"):
        c2, b2, _, _ = bh.fetch_full(root + path)
        if c2 == 200 and len(b2 or "") > 30:
            n += _emit(bh, pid, "m104", "debug surface exposed", "medium", root + path, 0,
                       b2[:200])
    return n


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------- entry

def run(bh, pid, targets=None):
    p = bh.getp(pid)
    if not p:
        return 0
    if not bh._envb("BH_DEEP", True):
        return 0
    limit = bh._envi("BH_DEEP_MAX", 6)
    targets = targets or bh.collect_targets(pid)
    n = done = 0
    for t in targets:
        if done >= limit or bh.STOP.is_set():
            break
        if bh.ADDR_RE.fullmatch(t):
            chain = bh.chain_of(t)
            if not chain:
                continue
            done += 1
            try:
                n += contract_checks(bh, pid, t, chain)
            except Exception as ex:
                bh.log(pid, "deep: %s %s" % (t[:12], ex))
        elif "github.com" in t:
            m = re.search(r"github\.com/([\w.-]+)/([\w.-]+)", t)
            if not m:
                continue
            done += 1
            try:
                meta, owner, repo = bh._resolve_repo(pid, m.group(1), m.group(2).rstrip("."))
                if not meta:
                    continue
                tree = json.loads(bh.gh("/repos/%s/%s/git/trees/HEAD?recursive=1"
                                        % (owner, repo)))
                files = [x["path"] for x in tree.get("tree") or []
                         if x.get("type") == "blob"
                         and x["path"].lower().endswith((".sol", ".rs"))]
                files.sort(key=lambda q: (0 if "/src/" in "/" + q else 1, len(q)))
                files = files[:bh._envi("BH_DEEP_FILES", 6)]
                if files:
                    n += repo_checks(bh, pid, owner, repo, files)
            except Exception as ex:
                bh.log(pid, "deep: repo %s" % ex)
    if p["url"].startswith("http"):
        try:
            n += web_checks(bh, pid, p["url"])
        except Exception as ex:
            bh.log(pid, "deep: web %s" % ex)
    bh.log(pid, "deep: %d hit(s) total" % n)
    return n
Save both, then:

bat
python -m py_compile bh.py deep.py
python selftest.py
run.bat
Files now on disk and unchanged: platforms.py, contract.py, manual.py, ui.html, selftest.py, run.bat, .env.

Optional .env lines to tune the new step: BH_DEEP=1, BH_DEEP_MAX=6, BH_DEEP_FILES=6. BH_DEEP=0 switches the step off without editing code.

The startup banner now prints a deep: line so you can confirm the step is on. If selftest.py counts steps and complains about 8 instead of 7, that is expected — it reads the step table, and the extra step is deep.

Repository & Secret Auditing

When bug bounty scopes include public code repositories or client-side JavaScript files, hunters audit them for hardcoded credentials and leaked API keys.
• TruffleHog & Gitleaks. Secret-scanning tools that search git commit histories and repositories for high-entropy strings, API tokens, and private keys.
• GitHound & SecretFinder. Reconnaissance scripts designed to scan public code searches and remote JavaScript files for exposed tokens and endpoints.
• Curated Lists. You can browse categorized open-source utilities in the Awesome Bug Bounty Tools Repository on GitHub.

Bug Bounty Platforms & Learning Resources

Before running any tools against a target, verify your scope on authorized platforms such as HackerOne, Intigriti, or YesWeHack. Many of these platforms also provide browser extensions (like PwnFox or VDP Finder) and educational labs to practice vulnerability identification safely.

def _net_wait(host):
    now = time.time()
    gap = max(NET_GAP + NET_PENALTY[0], 0.0)
    wait = max(0.0, gap - (now - HOST_LAST.get(host, 0.0)))
    while wait > 0:
        if STOP.is_set():
            return
        time.sleep(min(0.2, wait))
        wait = max(0.0, gap - (time.time() - HOST_LAST.get(host, 0.0)))
So parallel hosts proceed in parallel; same host still paced. Good — that alone cuts the 1400s passes dramatically.

python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""sekret.py - credential and endpoint harvesting.

Called by bh.py as sekret.run(bh, pid). TruffleHog and SecretFinder in one
pass: entropy plus known-provider patterns over page source, linked javascript,
source maps, repo files and git history. Every hit is stored with context and
redacted, and verifiable providers are checked live.

Findings are written with a proof artifact and the endpoint harvest is folded
back into details.txt so the scanner keeps expanding on its own.
"""
import json
import math
import re

MAX_FILES = 15
MAX_BYTES = 600000
ENTROPY_MIN = 4.0
ENTROPY_LEN = 20

SUSPECT_EXT = (".js", ".mjs", ".map", ".json", ".txt", ".env", ".yml", ".yaml",
               ".ts", ".jsx", ".tsx", ".php", ".py", ".rb", ".go", ".sol", ".rs",
               ".properties", ".cfg", ".ini", ".xml", ".html")

SKIP_EXT = (".png", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".gif", ".svg", ".webp", ".ico", ".woff",
            ".woff2", ".ttf", ".mp4", ".zip")

PATTERNS = [
    ("private key block", r"-----BEGIN (?:RSA |EC |OPENSSH |DSA |PGP )?PRIVATE KEY-----",
     "critical", "crypto", "none"),
    ("aws access key id", r"\b(?:AKIA|ASIA)[0-9A-Z]{16}\b", "critical", "crypto", "none"),
    ("aws secret key", r"(?i)aws_?secret_?access_?key\s*[:=]\s*[\"']?([A-Za-z0-9/+=]{40})",
     "critical", "crypto", "none"),
    ("github token", r"\bgh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9]{36,}\b", "critical", "crypto", "github"),
    ("gitlab token", r"\bglpat-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}\b", "critical", "crypto", "none"),
    ("slack webhook", r"https://hooks\.slack\.com/services/[A-Za-z0-9/]{30,}",
     "critical", "crypto", "slack"),
    ("slack token", r"\bxox[baprs]-[A-Za-z0-9-]{10,}", "high", "crypto", "none"),
    ("stripe live key", r"\bsk_live_[A-Za-z0-9]{16,}", "critical", "crypto", "none"),
    ("stripe test key", r"\bsk_test_[A-Za-z0-9]{16,}", "medium", "crypto", "none"),
    ("google api key", r"\bAIza[0-9A-Za-z_-]{35}\b", "high", "crypto", "google"),
    ("firebase url", r"https://[a-z0-9-]+\.firebaseio\.com", "medium", "web", "none"),
    ("npm token", r"\bnpm_[A-Za-z0-9]{36}\b", "high", "crypto", "npm"),
    ("pypi token", r"\bpypi-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{40,}", "high", "crypto", "none"),
    ("sendgrid key", r"\bSG\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}", "high", "crypto", "none"),
    ("mailgun key", r"\bkey-[0-9a-f]{32}\b", "medium", "crypto", "none"),
    ("twilio sid", r"\bAC[0-9a-f]{32}\b", "medium", "crypto", "none"),
    ("openai key", r"\bsk-(?:proj-)?[A-Za-z0-9_-]{32,}", "high", "crypto", "none"),
    ("anthropic key", r"\bsk-ant-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}", "high", "crypto", "none"),
    ("huggingface token", r"\bhf_[A-Za-z0-9]{30,}\b", "high", "crypto", "none"),
    ("discord webhook", r"https://(?:ptb\.|canary\.)?discord(?:app)?\.com/api/webhooks/\d+/[\w-]+",
     "medium", "web", "none"),
    ("telegram bot token", r"\b\d{8,10}:AA[A-Za-z0-9_-]{30,}", "high", "crypto", "none"),
    ("supabase service role", r"\beyJ[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}\.eyJ[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}",
     "high", "crypto", "none"),
    ("cloudflare token", r"\b[A-Za-z0-9_-]{40}\b(?=.*cloudflare)", "low", "crypto", "none"),
    ("basic auth in url", r"https?://[^\s:@/]+:[^\s@/]{6,}@[^\s/]+", "medium", "crypto", "none"),
    ("db connection string", r"(?:postgres|postgresql|mysql|mongodb(?:\+srv)?|redis|amqp)://[^\s\"'<>]{10,}",
     "high", "crypto", "none"),
]

ENDPOINT_RE = re.compile(
    r"""(?:https?|wss?)://[A-Za-z0-9._-]+(?::\d+)?(?:/[A-Za-z0-9._~%!$&'()*+,;=:@/-]*)?|"""
    r"""["'](/(?:api|v\d|graphql|rest|internal|admin|auth|oauth|upload|export)[A-Za-z0-9._~%!$&'()*+,;=:@/-]*)["']""")

SKIP_HOST = ("w3.org", "schema.org", "gmpg.org", "jsdelivr.net", "unpkg.com",
             "googleapis.com", "gstatic.com", "cloudflare.com", "github.com/assets",
             "bootstrapcdn", "jquery.com", "fontawesome", "cdnjs")

ALLOW_LOW = re.compile(r"^(?:true|false|null|undefined|localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)$", re.I)


def _entropy(s):
    if not s:
        return 0.0
    counts = {}
    for ch in s:
        counts[ch] = counts.get(ch, 0) + 1
    n = float(len(s))
    return -sum((c / n) * math.log(c / n, 2) for c in counts.values())


def _looks_secret(s):
    if len(s) < ENTROPY_LEN or ALLOW_LOW.match(s):
        return False
    if s.isalpha() or s.isdigit():
        return False
    if re.fullmatch(r"[a-f0-9]+", s):
        return len(s) >= 32 and _entropy(s) >= 3.0
    if re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9+/=_-]+", s):
        return _entropy(s) >= ENTROPY_MIN
    return False


def _redact(s):
    if len(s) <= 12:
        return s
    return "%s...%s (%d chars)" % (s[:6], s[-4:], len(s))


def _emit(bh, pid, tool, title, sev, file, evidence, proof=None):
    t = bh.TOOLS.get(tool, {})
    try:
        with bh.db() as c:
            if c.execute("SELECT id FROM findings WHERE pid=? AND title=? AND file=?",
                         (pid, title[:300], file[:300])).fetchone():
                return 0
            cur = c.execute(
                "INSERT INTO findings(pid,title,sev,cls,file,line,evidence,score,fund,reward,"
                "tool,ts) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
                (pid, title[:300], sev, t.get("cls", "crypto"), file[:300], 0,
                 evidence[:20000],
                 min(100, bh.SEV_W.get(sev, 14) + t.get("reward", 0) // 400
                     + min(12, len(evidence) // 120) + 8),
                 1 if t.get("fund") else 0, bh.REWARD.get(t.get("cls", ""), 0),
                 tool, __import__("time").time()))
            fid = cur.lastrowid
    except Exception:
        return 0
    if proof:
        try:
            d = bh.project_dir(pid) / "secrets"
            d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            fn = d / ("%s.proof.txt" % fid)
            fn.write_text(proof[:20000], encoding="utf-8")
            with bh.db() as c:
                c.execute("UPDATE findings SET poc_path=? WHERE id=?", (str(fn), fid))
        except Exception:
            pass
    return 1


def _verify(bh, kind, value):
    try:
        if kind == "github":
            code, body, _, _ = bh.fetch_full(
                "https://api.github.com/user",
                headers={"Authorization": "token " + value, "Accept": "application/vnd.github+json"})
            if code == 200:
                try:
                    return "valid, identity %s" % json.loads(body).get("login", "?")
                except Exception:
                    return "valid"
            return "rejected (%d)" % code
        if kind == "slack":
            code, body, _, _ = bh.fetch_full(value, data=b'{"text":"bh"}',
                                             headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
                                             method="POST")
            return "valid" if code == 200 and body.strip() == "ok" else "rejected (%d)" % code
        if kind == "google":
            code, body, _, _ = bh.fetch_full(
                "https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/geocode/json?address=x&key=" + value)
            return "rejected" if "REQUEST_DENIED" in body else "accepted"
        if kind == "npm":
            code, _, _, _ = bh.fetch_full("https://registry.npmjs.org/-/whoami",
                                          headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + value})
            return "valid" if code == 200 else "rejected (%d)" % code
    except Exception as ex:
        return "unknown (%s)" % str(ex)[:40]
    return "unchecked"


def _scan_text(bh, pid, where, text, verify_budget):
    n = 0
    seen = set()
    for name, pat, sev, cls, kind in PATTERNS:
        for m in re.finditer(pat, text):
            val = m.group(0)
            key = (name, val[:60])
            if key in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(key)
            line = text[:m.start()].count("\n") + 1
            ctx = text[max(0, m.start() - 90):m.end() + 90].replace("\n", " ")
            verdict = ""
            if kind != "none" and verify_budget[0] > 0:
                verify_budget[0] -= 1
                verdict = _verify(bh, kind, val)
                if verdict.startswith("rejected"):
                    sev = "low"
                elif verdict.startswith("valid") or verdict.startswith("accepted"):
                    sev = "critical"
            n += _emit(bh, pid, "m100", "%s in %s" % (name, where), sev,
                       "%s#L%d" % (where, line),
                       "match %s\nverification: %s\ncontext: %s"
                       % (_redact(val), verdict or "not checked", ctx[:600]),
                       proof="%s line %d\nvalue: %s\nverification: %s\n\n%s\n"
                             % (where, line, val, verdict or "-", ctx))
            if len(seen) > 60:
                break
    for m in re.finditer(r"[\"']([A-Za-z0-9+/=_\-]{20,120})[\"']", text):
        val = m.group(1)
        if not _looks_secret(val):
            continue
        key = ("entropy", val[:60])
        if key in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(key)
        line = text[:m.start()].count("\n") + 1
        ctx = text[max(0, m.start() - 90):m.end() + 90].replace("\n", " ")
        n += _emit(bh, pid, "m100", "high entropy string in %s" % where, "medium",
                   "%s#L%d" % (where, line),
                   "value %s, entropy %.2f\ncontext: %s"
                   % (_redact(val), _entropy(val), ctx[:600]),
                   proof="%s line %d\nentropy %.2f\n%s\n" % (where, line, _entropy(val), ctx))
        if n > 40:
            break
    return n


def _endpoints(bh, pid, text, bucket):
    for m in ENDPOINT_RE.finditer(text):
        u = m.group(0).strip("\"'")
        if len(u) < 6 or any(s in u for s in SKIP_HOST):
            continue
        if u.startswith("/"):
            continue
        if u not in bucket:
            bucket.append(u)


def _fetch_js(bh, pid, page):
    n = 0
    srcs = []
    for m in re.finditer(r'<script[^>]+src="([^"]+)"', page or ""):
        u = m.group(1)
        if u.startswith("//"):
            u = "https:" + u
        elif u.startswith("/"):
            u = "https://" + bh.urlparse(page).netloc + u
        if u not in srcs:
            srcs.append(u)
    for m in re.finditer(r'"(/[A-Za-z0-9._/-]+\.js)"', page or ""):
        u = "https://" + bh.urlparse(page).netloc + m.group(1)
        if u not in srcs:
            srcs.append(u)
    budget = [8]
    endpoints = []
    for u in srcs[:MAX_FILES]:
        if bh.STOP.is_set() or budget[0] <= 0:
            break
        code, body, _, _ = bh.fetch_full(u, timeout=25)
        if not code or code >= 400 or not body:
            continue
        budget[0] -= 1
        bh.log(pid, "sekret: js %s %d bytes" % (u, len(body)))
        n += _scan_text(bh, pid, u, body[:MAX_BYTES], [2])
        _endpoints(bh, pid, body, endpoints)
        if ".js.map" in body or "sourceMappingURL" in body:
            n += _source_map(bh, pid, u)
    if endpoints:
        _merge(bh, pid, endpoints)
    return n


def _source_map(bh, pid, js_url):
    m = re.search(r"sourceMappingURL=([\w./-]+\.map)", js_url) or \
        re.search(r"//# sourceMappingURL=([\w./-]+\.map)", "")
    cand = []
    if m:
        cand.append(m.group(1))
    cand.append(js_url.split("?")[0] + ".map")
    for c in cand:
        if c.startswith("http"):
            u = c
        elif c.startswith("/"):
            u = "https://" + bh.urlparse(js_url).netloc + c
        else:
            u = js_url.rsplit("/", 1)[0] + "/" + c
        code, body, _, _ = bh.fetch_full(u, timeout=30)
        if code == 200 and "sourcesContent" in body:
            bh.log(pid, "sekret: source map %s" % u)
            n = _emit(bh, pid, "m104", "source map exposes original source", "medium", u,
                      "sourcesContent present, %d bytes" % len(body),
                      proof="GET %s -> 200, %d bytes\n" % (u, len(body)))
            return n + _scan_text(bh, pid, u, body[:MAX_BYTES], [0])
    return 0


def _merge(bh, pid, endpoints):
    f = bh.project_dir(pid) / "details.txt"
    have = f.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore") if f.exists() else ""
    new = [u for u in endpoints if u not in have]
    if not new:
        return 0
    with f.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        fh.write("\n\n# endpoints harvested by sekret\n")
        for u in new[:60]:
            fh.write(u + "\n")
    bh.log(pid, "sekret: %d endpoint(s) added to scope text" % len(new))
    return len(new)


def _repo(bh, pid, owner, repo):
    n = 0
    try:
        tree = json.loads(bh.gh("/repos/%s/%s/git/trees/HEAD?recursive=1" % (owner, repo)))
    except Exception as ex:
        bh.log(pid, "sekret: tree %s" % ex)
        return 0
    files = [x["path"] for x in tree.get("tree") or []
             if x.get("type") == "blob"
             and x["path"].lower().endswith(SUSPECT_EXT)
             and not x["path"].lower().endswith(SKIP_EXT)]
    files.sort(key=lambda p: (0 if p.lower().endswith((".env", ".json", ".yml", ".yaml"))
                              else 1, len(p)))
    endpoints = []
    for path in files[:MAX_FILES]:
        if bh.STOP.is_set():
            break
        try:
            body = bh.fetch("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/%s/%s/HEAD/%s"
                            % (owner, repo, path), timeout=25)[:MAX_BYTES]
        except Exception:
            continue
        n += _scan_text(bh, pid, "%s/%s" % (repo, path), body, [1])
        _endpoints(bh, pid, body, endpoints)
    try:
        commits = json.loads(bh.gh("/repos/%s/%s/commits?per_page=4" % (owner, repo)))
    except Exception:
        commits = []
    for cm in commits[:4]:
        sha = cm.get("sha")
        if not sha:
            continue
        try:
            detail = json.loads(bh.gh("/repos/%s/%s/commits/%s" % (owner, repo, sha)))
        except Exception:
            continue
        for f in detail.get("files") or []:
            patch = f.get("patch") or ""
            added = "\n".join(l[1:] for l in patch.splitlines() if l.startswith("+"))
            if added:
                n += _scan_text(bh, pid, "%s@%s:%s" % (repo, sha[:8], f.get("filename")),
                                added, [0])
    if endpoints:
        _merge(bh, pid, endpoints)
    return n


def run(bh, pid, targets=None):
    p = bh.getp(pid)
    if not p:
        return 0
    if not bh._envb("BH_SEKRET", True):
        return 0
    targets = targets or bh.collect_targets(pid)
    n = 0
    done = 0
    limit = bh._envi("BH_SEKRET_MAX", 4)
    for t in targets:
        if done >= limit or bh.STOP.is_set():
            break
        if "github.com" in t:
            m = re.search(r"github\.com/([\w.-]+)/([\w.-]+)", t)
            if not m:
                continue
            done += 1
            try:
                meta, owner, repo = bh._resolve_repo(pid, m.group(1), m.group(2).rstrip("."))
                if meta:
                    n += _repo(bh, pid, owner, repo)
            except Exception as ex:
                bh.log(pid, "sekret: repo %s" % ex)
        elif t.startswith("http") and done < limit:
            done += 1
            try:
                code, body, hdrs, _ = bh.fetch_full(t)
                if code and code < 400:
                    n += _scan_text(bh, pid, t, body[:MAX_BYTES], [1])
                    n += _fetch_js(bh, pid, t)
            except Exception as ex:
                bh.log(pid, "sekret: %s" % ex)
    if p["url"].startswith("http"):
        try:
            code, body, _, _ = bh.fetch_full(p["url"])
            if code and code < 400:
                n += _scan_text(bh, pid, p["url"], body[:MAX_BYTES], [2])
                n += _fetch_js(bh, pid, p["url"])
        except Exception as ex:
            bh.log(pid, "sekret: page %s" % ex)
    bh.log(pid, "sekret: %d hit(s)" % n)
    return n

def load_env(path=None):
    p = Path(path or (HERE / ".env"))
    if not p.exists():
        return
    for raw in p.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore").splitlines():
        line = raw.strip()
        if not line or line.startswith("#") or "=" not in line:
            continue
        k, v = line.split("=", 1)
        k = k.strip()
        v = v.strip().strip('"').strip("'")
        if k in os.environ and os.environ[k] != v:
            DUPES.append(k)
        os.environ[k] = v

def _build():
    tools = {}
    for i, line in enumerate([l for l in RAW.strip().splitlines() if l.strip()], 1):
        cls, name, sev, langs, lvl, fund = [p.strip() for p in line.split("|")]
        tools["m%03d" % i] = {"name": name, "cls": cls, "sev": sev,
                              "langs": [x for x in langs.split(",") if x], "lvl": int(lvl),
                              "fund": fund == "1",

    return tools

def _cols(c, table):
    return {r["name"] for r in c.execute("PRAGMA table_info(%s)" % table)}


def init():
    WORK.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with db() as c:
        c.execute("""CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS projects(
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, url TEXT UNIQUE, slug TEXT, name TEXT,
            status TEXT, stage TEXT, cycle INTEGER DEFAULT 0, attempts INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
            escalation INTEGER DEFAULT 0, toolchain TEXT DEFAULT 'unknown',
            type_conf TEXT DEFAULT 'unresolved', type_evidence TEXT DEFAULT '{}',
            type_locked INTEGER DEFAULT 0, max INTEGER DEFAULT 0, rank INTEGER DEFAULT 50,
            tvl INTEGER DEFAULT 0, details_ok INTEGER DEFAULT 0, cond_ok INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
            targets_n INTEGER DEFAULT 0, readiness INTEGER DEFAULT 0, fund_hits INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
            auto INTEGER DEFAULT 1, source TEXT DEFAULT 'auto', manual INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
            notes TEXT DEFAULT '', added REAL, updated REAL)""")
        c.execute("""CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS findings(
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, pid INTEGER, title TEXT, sev TEXT,
            cls TEXT, file TEXT, line INTEGER, evidence TEXT, score INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
            fund INTEGER DEFAULT 0, reward INTEGER DEFAULT 0, gate TEXT DEFAULT '',
            blockers TEXT DEFAULT '[]', judged INTEGER DEFAULT 0, eligible INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
            poc_path TEXT DEFAULT '', tool TEXT, ts REAL)""")
        c.execute("""CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS log(
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, pid INTEGER, ts REAL, line TEXT)""")
        c.execute("""CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS repairs(
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, pid INTEGER, kind TEXT, detail TEXT, ts REAL)""")
        c.execute("""CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS rejections(
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, url TEXT, why TEXT, ts REAL)""")
        c.execute("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS i_f ON findings(pid)")
        c.execute("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS i_l ON log(pid, id)")
        want = {
            "projects": [("slug", "TEXT"), ("source", "TEXT DEFAULT 'auto'"),
                         ("manual", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"), ("notes", "TEXT DEFAULT ''"),
                         ("added", "REAL"), ("updated", "REAL"),
                         ("type_locked", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
                         ("type_evidence", "TEXT DEFAULT '{}'"),
                         ("targets_n", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
                         ("dry", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0")],
            "findings": [("blockers", "TEXT DEFAULT '[]'"), ("judged", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
                         ("eligible", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"), ("reward", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
                         ("poc_path", "TEXT DEFAULT ''"), ("tool", "TEXT")],
        }
        for table, cols in want.items():
            have = _cols(c, table)
            for name, decl in cols:
                if name not in have:
                    c.execute("ALTER TABLE %s ADD COLUMN %s %s" % (table, name, decl))


def _conn():
    c = getattr(_LOCAL, "c", None)
    if c is None:
        c = sqlite3.connect(DB, timeout=15, isolation_level=None)
        c.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
        c.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL")
        c.execute("PRAGMA synchronous=NORMAL")
        c.execute("PRAGMA busy_timeout=15000")
        _LOCAL.c = c
    return c


@contextmanager
def db():
    yield _conn()


def log(pid, line):
    line = str(line)[:4000]
    ts = time.time()
    slug = ""
    try:
        with db() as c:
            c.execute("INSERT INTO log(pid,ts,line) VALUES(?,?,?)", (pid, ts, line))
            r = c.execute("SELECT slug FROM projects WHERE id=?", (pid,)).fetchone()
            slug = (r["slug"] if r else "") or ""
    except Exception:
        pass
    try:
        LOGQ.put_nowait((slug, ts, line))
    except queue.Full:
        pass
    print("[%s] %s" % (pid, line), flush=True)


def log_writer():
    while not STOP.is_set():
        try:
            slug, ts, line = LOGQ.get(timeout=1.0)
        except queue.Empty:
            continue
        try:
            d = WORK / (slug or "0")
            d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            with (d / "log.txt").open("a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                f.write("%s %s\n" % (time.strftime("%H:%M:%S", time.localtime(ts)), line))
        except Exception:
            pass


def heartbeat():
    while not STOP.is_set():
        time.sleep(20)
        try:
            with RUN_LOCK:
                live = sorted(RUNNING.keys())
            with db() as c:
                t0 = time.time()
                c.execute("SELECT 1").fetchone()
                dbms = int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)
            log(0, "hb: %d live, queue %d, db %dms, net %.1fs, discover %s"
                % (len(live), JOBQ.qsize(), dbms, NET_TIME[0],
                   "on" if AUTO_DISCOVER else "off"))
        except Exception as ex:
            log(0, "hb: %s" % str(ex)[:120])


def _hlock(host):
    with HOST_LOCK_G:
        l = HOST_LOCK.get(host)
        if l is None:
            l = threading.Lock()
            HOST_LOCK[host] = l
    return l


def _net_wait(host):
    gap = max(NET_GAP + NET_PENALTY[0], 0.0)
    while True:
        wait = gap - (time.time() - HOST_LAST.get(host, 0.0))
        if wait <= 0:
            return
        if STOP.is_set():
            return
        time.sleep(min(0.2, wait))


def _penalise(code, retry=""):
    if code in (429, 503) or (code == 403 and retry):
        NET_PENALTY[0] = min(NET_MAX_PENALTY, max(NET_PENALTY[0] * 1.6, 1.5))
    else:
        NET_PENALTY[0] = max(0.0, NET_PENALTY[0] * 0.75)


def fetch_full(url, headers=None, timeout=30, data=None, method="GET"):
    host = urlparse(url).netloc
    code, body, hdrs, cookies = 0, "", {}, []
    for attempt in (0, 1):
        with _hlock(host):
            _net_wait(host)
            t0 = time.time()
            h = {"User-Agent": UA, "Accept": "*/*"}
            h.update(headers or {})
            code, body, hdrs, cookies = 0, "", {}, []
            try:
                import urllib.request
                req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers=h, data=data, method=method)
                with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=timeout) as r:
                    code = r.status
                    body = r.read(SCAN_BYTES).decode("utf-8", "replace")
                    hdrs = {k.lower(): v for k, v in r.headers.items()}
                    cookies = r.headers.get_all("Set-Cookie") or []
            except Exception as ex:
                code = getattr(ex, "code", 0) or 0
                eh = getattr(ex, "headers", None)
                if code and eh is not None:
                    try:
                        body = ex.read(SCAN_BYTES).decode("utf-8", "replace")
                    except Exception:
                        body = ""
                    hdrs = {k.lower(): v for k, v in eh.items()}
                    cookies = eh.get_all("Set-Cookie") or []
            finally:
                NET_LAST[0] = time.time()
                NET_TIME[0] += time.time() - t0
                HOST_LAST[host] = NET_LAST[0]
                _penalise(code, hdrs.get("retry-after", ""))
        if code != 429 or attempt:
            break
        try:
            delay = min(20.0, float(hdrs.get("retry-after") or 4))
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            delay = 4.0
        if STOP.is_set():
            break
        time.sleep(delay)
    return code, body, hdrs, cookies


def fetch(url, headers=None, timeout=45, data=None, method="GET"):
    code, body, hdrs, _ = fetch_full(url, headers=headers, timeout=timeout, data=data,
                                     method=method)
    if code >= 400 or not code:
        raise RuntimeError("HTTP %d" % code)
    return body


def gh(path, timeout=30):
    h = {"Accept": "application/vnd.github+json"}
    if PAT:
        h["Authorization"] = "Bearer " + PAT
    return fetch("https://api.github.com" + path, headers=h, timeout=timeout)


_SEL = {"totalAssets": "0x01e1d114", "totalSupply": "0x18160ddd", "decimals": "0x313ce567"}
_CHAIN = {}


def rpc(chain, method, params):
    url = RPC.get(chain)
    if not url:
        raise RuntimeError("no rpc for chain %s" % chain)
    body = json.dumps({"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": method, "params": params}).encode()
    raw = fetch(url, headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"}, data=body,
                method="POST", timeout=25)
    out = json.loads(raw)
    if "error" in out:
        raise RuntimeError(out["error"].get("message", "rpc error"))
    return out.get("result")


def chain_of(address):
    if address in _CHAIN:
        return _CHAIN[address]
    for chain in RPC:
        try:
            if rpc(chain, "eth_getCode", [address, "latest"]) not in (None, "0x"):
                _CHAIN[address] = chain
                return chain
        except Exception:
            continue
    return 0


def _uint(hexstr):
    if not hexstr or hexstr == "0x":
        return 0
    try:
        return int(hexstr, 16)
    except ValueError:
        return 0


def abi_of(chain, address):
    d = WORK / "abi"
    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    f = d / ("%s-%s.json" % (chain, address))
    if f.exists():
        try:
            return json.loads(f.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        except Exception:
            return []
    if not ETHERSCAN:
        return []
    try:
        raw = fetch("https://api.etherscan.io/v2/api?chainid=%d&module=contract&action=getabi"
                    "&address=%s&apikey=%s" % (chain, address, ETHERSCAN), timeout=25)
        j = json.loads(raw)
        abi = json.loads(j.get("result") or "[]") if j.get("status") == "1" else []
    except Exception:
        abi = []
    f.write_text(json.dumps(abi), encoding="utf-8")
    return abi


def fork_block(chain):
    if FORK_BLOCK:
        try:
            return int(FORK_BLOCK)
        except ValueError:
            pass
    try:
        latest = _uint(rpc(chain, "eth_blockNumber", []))
    except Exception:
        return 0
    return max(0, latest - FORK_OFFSET)


def census(pid):
    if not VALUE_CENSUS:
        return 0
    if not getp(pid):
        return 0
    targets = [t.get("address") for t in (load_conditions(pid).get("targets") or [])
               if t.get("address")]
    addrs = [t for t in targets if ADDR_RE.fullmatch(t or "")]
    log(pid, "census: %d address target(s) of %d in scope" % (len(addrs), len(targets)))
    if not addrs:
        return 0
    lines, total = [], 0
    for addr in addrs[:40]:
        chain = chain_of(addr)
        if not chain:
            lines.append("%s  no code on configured chains" % addr)
            continue
        try:
            bal = _uint(rpc(chain, "eth_getBalance", [addr, "latest"]))
        except Exception as ex:
            lines.append("%s  balance error: %s" % (addr, ex))
            continue
        assets = supply = dec = 0
        names = {e.get("name") for e in abi_of(chain, addr) if e.get("type") == "function"}
        for fn in ("totalAssets", "totalSupply", "decimals"):
            if names and fn not in names:
                continue
            try:
                v = _uint(rpc(chain, "eth_call", [{"to": addr, "data": _SEL[fn]}, "latest"]))
            except Exception:
                v = 0
            if fn == "totalAssets":
                assets = v
            elif fn == "totalSupply":
                supply = v
            else:
                dec = v
        held = max(bal, assets)
        if supply and 0 < dec <= 36:
            held = max(held, supply * 10 ** (18 - dec) if dec < 18 else supply // (10 ** (dec - 18)))
        total += held
        eth = held / 1e18
        lines.append("%s  chain %d  native %.6f  assets %.6f  supply %d  -> %.6f ETH  $%.0f"
                     % (addr, chain, bal / 1e18, assets / 1e18, supply, eth, eth * ETH_USD))
        fb = fork_block(chain)
        if fb:
            lines.append("    fork: chain %d block %d" % (chain, fb))
    (project_dir(pid) / "value.txt").write_text("\n".join(lines), encoding="utf-8")
    setp(pid, tvl=total)
    log(pid, "census: %.6f ETH-eq, $%.0f" % (total / 1e18, total / 1e18 * ETH_USD))
    return total


def add_project(url, name="", source="auto", toolchain="unknown", max_bounty=0, rank=50,
                manual_flag=0, details=0, locked=0):
    url = (url or "").strip()
    if not url:
        return 0
    with db() as c:
        r = c.execute("SELECT id FROM projects WHERE url=?", (url,)).fetchone()
        if r:
            c.execute("UPDATE projects SET updated=?, auto=1 WHERE id=?", (time.time(), r["id"]))
            return r["id"]
        nm = name or urlparse(url).netloc or url
        cur = c.execute(
            "INSERT INTO projects(url,name,status,stage,toolchain,max,rank,source,manual,"
            "details_ok,type_locked,added,updated) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
            (url, nm[:80], "new", "", toolchain, max_bounty, rank, source, manual_flag,
             details, locked, time.time(), time.time()))
        pid = cur.lastrowid
        c.execute("UPDATE projects SET slug=? WHERE id=?", (manual.slugify(nm, pid), pid))
    log(pid, "queued %s" % url)
    return pid


def setp(pid, **kw):
    if not kw:
        return
    kw["updated"] = time.time()
    cols = ", ".join("%s=?" % k for k in kw)
    with db() as c:
        c.execute("UPDATE projects SET %s WHERE id=?" % cols, (*kw.values(), pid))


def getp(pid):
    with db() as c:
        return c.execute("SELECT * FROM projects WHERE id=?", (pid,)).fetchone()


def running_pids():
    with RUN_LOCK:
        return set(RUNNING.keys())


def project_dir(pid):
    r = getp(pid)
    d = WORK / ((r["slug"] if r and r["slug"] else str(pid)))
    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    return d


def add_finding(pid, tool, title, sev, file="", line=0, evidence="", **kw):
    t = TOOLS.get(tool, {})
    base = SEV_W.get(sev, 14) + t.get("reward", 0) // 400
    proof = 8 if (line or ":" in (file or "")) else 0
    score = min(100, base + min(12, len(evidence) // 120) + proof)
    with db() as c:
        cur = c.execute(
            "INSERT INTO findings(pid,title,sev,cls,file,line,evidence,score,fund,reward,"
            "tool,ts) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
            (pid, title[:300], sev, t.get("cls", "logic"), file[:300], line,
             evidence[:20000], score, 1 if t.get("fund") else 0,
             kw.get("reward", 0), tool, time.time()))
        return cur.lastrowid


def findings(pid):
    with db() as c:
        return c.execute("SELECT * FROM findings WHERE pid=? ORDER BY score DESC",
                         (pid,)).fetchall()


def load_conditions(pid):
    f = project_dir(pid) / "contract.json"
    if not f.exists():
        return {}
    try:
        return json.loads(f.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except Exception:
        return {}


def parse_scope(pid, text=None):
    p = getp(pid)
    if not p:
        return {}
    d = project_dir(pid)
    fn = getattr(contract, "parse_program", None)
    if not fn:
        return {}
    tries = []
    if text is not None:
        tries = [lambda: fn(p["url"], d, text=text), lambda: fn(pid, d, text=text),
                 lambda: fn(p["url"], str(d), text)]
    else:
        tries = [lambda: fn(p["url"], d), lambda: fn(p["url"], str(d)),
                 lambda: fn(pid, d)]
    for t in tries:
        try:
            return t() or {}
        except TypeError:
            continue
        except Exception as ex:
            log(pid, "parse: %s" % ex)
            return {}
    return {}


def _poc_on_disk(f):
    if not f["poc_path"]:
        return False
    try:
        return Path(f["poc_path"]).exists()
    except Exception:
        return False


def _blockers(f, pol):
    b = []
    ex = pol.get("exclusions") or {}
    surf = " ".join(ex.get("surfaces") or []).lower()
    for word in ("cdn", "third-party", "testnet", "mock"):
        if word in surf and word in (f["file"] or "").lower():
            b.append("out of scope: " + word)
    if (pol.get("poc") or {}).get("required") and f["score"] >= THRESHOLD \
            and not _poc_on_disk(f):
        b.append("poc required")
    for nv in ex.get("non_vulns") or []:
        head = nv.lower()[:24]
        if head and head in (f["title"] or "").lower():
            b.append("known non-vuln")
            break
    return b


def gate(pid):
    if not getp(pid):
        return
    pol = load_conditions(pid)
    rows = findings(pid)
    eligible = money = judged = 0
    for f in rows:
        if f["sev"] == "info":
            with db() as c:
                c.execute("UPDATE findings SET blockers='[]', judged=1, eligible=0 WHERE id=?",
                          (f["id"],))
            continue
        judged += 1
        bl = _blockers(f, pol)
        ok = not bl and f["score"] >= THRESHOLD
        with db() as c:
            c.execute("UPDATE findings SET blockers=?, judged=1, eligible=? WHERE id=?",
                      (json.dumps(bl), 1 if ok else 0, f["id"]))
        eligible += 1 if ok else 0
        money += 1 if (ok and f["fund"]) else 0
    score = int(100 * eligible / judged) if judged else 0
    setp(pid, readiness=score, fund_hits=money)
    log(pid, "gate: %d findings, %d judged, %d eligible, %d money, readiness %d"
        % (len(rows), judged, eligible, money, score))


def _details_ok(pid):
    d = project_dir(pid)
    for name in ("details.json", "details.txt", "details.html"):
        f = d / name
        if f.exists() and f.stat().st_size > 200:
            return True
    return False


def step_intake(ctx):
    pid = ctx["pid"]
    p = getp(pid)
    if not p:
        return ctx
    if p["manual"]:
        ctx["details_ok"] = True
        log(pid, "intake: manual project, details gate bypassed")
    elif _details_ok(pid):
        if not p["details_ok"]:
            setp(pid, details_ok=1, status="ready")
        ctx["details_ok"] = True
        log(pid, "intake: details on disk")
    else:
        setp(pid, details_ok=0)
        log(pid, "intake: details missing, fetching %s" % p["url"])
        try:
            n = platforms.details(p["url"], project_dir(pid))
            setp(pid, details_ok=1, status="ready")
            ctx["details_ok"] = True
            log(pid, "intake: details saved, %s bytes" % n)
        except Exception as ex:
            setp(pid, status="needs-details")
            log(pid, "intake: details failed: %s" % ex)
    if not p["type_locked"] and p["toolchain"] in ("unknown", ""):
        try:
            tc, conf, ev = platforms.resolve_type(project_dir(pid), p["url"])
        except Exception as ex:
            tc, conf, ev = "unknown", "unresolved", {"reason": str(ex)}
        if tc != "unknown":
            setp(pid, toolchain=tc, type_conf=conf, type_evidence=json.dumps(ev)[:4000])
            log(pid, "intake: type %s (%s)" % (tc, conf))
        else:
            setp(pid, type_evidence=json.dumps(ev)[:4000])
            log(pid, "intake: type unknown (unresolved)")
    return ctx


def step_conditions(ctx):
    pid = ctx["pid"]
    existing = load_conditions(pid)
    if existing and existing.get("targets"):
        setp(pid, cond_ok=1, targets_n=len(existing.get("targets") or []))
        log(pid, "conditions: %d target(s) already parsed" % len(existing.get("targets") or []))
        if VALUE_CENSUS and not (project_dir(pid) / "value.txt").exists():
            try:
                census(pid)
            except Exception as ex:
                log(pid, "census: %s" % ex)
        return ctx
    pol = parse_scope(pid)
    if pol and pol.get("targets"):
        try:
            contract.save_conditions(pid, **pol)
        except Exception as ex:
            log(pid, "conditions: save failed: %s" % ex)
        n = len(pol.get("targets") or [])
        setp(pid, cond_ok=1, targets_n=n)
        log(pid, "conditions: %d targets, %d tiers" % (n, len(pol.get("severity") or [])))
        if VALUE_CENSUS:
            try:
                census(pid)
            except Exception as ex:
                log(pid, "census: %s" % ex)
        return ctx
    setp(pid, cond_ok=0, targets_n=0)
    log(pid, "conditions: nothing parsed, scan uses the url and saved text")
    return ctx


def step_brief(ctx):
    pid = ctx["pid"]
    pol = load_conditions(pid)
    ctx["brief"] = pol
    log(pid, "brief: scope %s, poc %s, %d target(s)"
        % (pol.get("scope_model") or "unknown", (pol.get("poc") or {}).get("required"),
           len(pol.get("targets") or [])))
    return ctx


ADDR_RE = re.compile(r"\b0x[a-fA-F0-9]{40}\b")
URL_RE = re.compile(r"https?://[^\s\"'<>)\]]+")


def _valid_url(u):
    try:
        pr = urlparse(u)
    except Exception:
        return False
    if pr.scheme not in ("http", "https"):
        return False
    host = pr.netloc.split("@")[-1].split(":")[0].lower()
    if not host or "." not in host:
        return False
    if host.rsplit(".", 1)[-1].isdigit():
        return False
    if any(j in host for j in JUNK):
        return False
    if pr.path.lower().endswith(IMG_EXT):
        return False
    return True


def _norm(u):
    pr = urlparse(u)
    path = LOCALE_RE.sub("/", pr.path or "/")
    return (pr.netloc.lower() + path.rstrip("/"))


def collect_targets(pid):
    p = getp(pid)
    if not p:
        return []
    out = []
    seen = set()
    own = urlparse(p["url"]).netloc
    own_key = _norm(p["url"])

    def push(x, own_page=False):
        x = x.strip().rstrip(".,);]'\"")
        if not x or x in out:
            return
        if x.startswith("http"):
            if not _valid_url(x):
                return
            key = _norm(x)
            if key == own_key and not own_page:
                return
            if key in seen:
                return
            seen.add(key)
        out.append(x)

    for t in (load_conditions(pid).get("targets") or []):
        if t.get("address"):
            push(t["address"])
    for name in ("details.txt", "details.html", "contract.json"):
        f = project_dir(pid) / name
        if not f.exists():
            continue
        try:
            txt = f.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")[:400000]
        except Exception:
            continue
        for m in ADDR_RE.finditer(txt):
            push(m.group(0))
        for m in URL_RE.finditer(txt):
            push(m.group(0))
    if p["url"].startswith("http"):
        push(p["url"], own_page=True)
    return out[:SCAN_TARGETS]
